        "contents": "export class OpenAIProvider implements ILLMProvider {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 处理错误\n   */\n  private handleError(error: any): Error {\n    if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {\n      const axiosError = error as AxiosError;\n      if (axiosError.response) {\n        const status = axiosError.response.status;\n        const data = axiosError.response.data as any;\n        \n        switch (status) {\n          case 401:\n            return new Error('API密钥无效');\n          case 429:\n            return new Error('请求频率过高，请稍后重试');\n          case 500:\n          case 502:\n          case 503:\n            return new Error('OpenAI服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试');\n          default:\n            return new Error(data?.error?.message || &#96;API请求失败: ${status}&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n      if (axiosError.code === 'ECONNABORTED') {\n        return new Error('请求超时，请稍后重试');\n      }\n      return new Error('网络错误，请检查网络连接');\n    }\n    return error instanceof Error ? error : new Error('未知错误');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 睡眠函数（用于重试延迟）\n   */\n  private sleep(ms: number): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    return new Promise(resolve =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, ms));\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "async function startServer() {\n\n    \n    // 初始化公共知识库数据库表\n    try {\n      const { publicKnowledgeModel } = await import('./models');\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('公共知识库数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('公共知识库数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    const server = app.listen(port, \"0.0.0.0\", () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('Backend server 已启动', { url: &#96;http://0.0.0.0:${port}&#96; });\n    });\n\n    // 保持进程运行\n    server.keepAliveTimeout = 0;\n    server.headersTimeout = 0;\n\n    // 优雅关闭处理\n    process.on('SIGTERM', () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('SIGTERM received, shutting down gracefully');\n      server.close(() =&gt; {\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\n        process.exit(0);\n      });\n    });\n\n    process.on('SIGINT', () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('SIGINT received, shutting down gracefully');\n      server.close(() =&gt; {\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\n        process.exit(0);\n      });\n    });\n\n    return server;\n  } catch (error) {\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\n      level: 'fatal',\n    });\n    logger.error('Failed to start server', { error });\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n}\n\nstartServer();",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 96
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Todify3 部署问题解决知识库\n\n## 🚨 紧急问题快速解决\n\n### 1. 服务无法启动\n\n#### 问题现象\n- 端口无法监听\n- 进程启动失败\n- 服务无响应\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查端口占用\nlsof -i :3001\nlsof -i :3003\nlsof -i :8088\n\n# 检查进程状态\nps aux | grep node\nps aux | grep nginx\n\n# 检查日志\ntail -f /root/todify2-deploy/backend/backend.log\ntail -f /root/todify2-deploy/frontend/frontend.log\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n1. **端口冲突**: 杀死占用进程或更换端口\n2. **权限问题**: 检查文件权限和用户权限\n3. **依赖缺失**: 重新安装npm依赖\n4. **配置错误**: 检查.env文件和配置文件\n\n### 2. API 404错误\n\n#### 问题现象\n- &#96;Failed to load resource: 404&#96;\n- API端点无法访问\n- 代理路由失效\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查路由注册\ncurl http://localhost:3003/api/health\ncurl http://47.113.225.93:8088/api/health\n\n# 检查Nginx配置\nnginx -t\nsystemctl status nginx\n\n# 检查后端路由\ngrep -r \"app.use\" /root/todify2-deploy/backend/src/\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n1. **路由未注册**: 检查&#96;index.ts&#96;中的路由注册\n2. **Nginx配置错误**: 检查代理配置\n3. **路径错误**: 检查API路径配置\n4. **服务未启动**: 重启相关服务\n\n### 3. CORS错误\n\n#### 问题现象\n- &#96;Access to fetch at ... has been blocked by CORS policy&#96;\n- 跨域请求失败\n- API调用被阻止\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查前端API配置\ngrep -r \"apiUrl\" /root/todify2-deploy/frontend/src/services/\n\n# 检查后端CORS配置\ngrep -r \"cors\" /root/todify2-deploy/backend/src/\n\n# 测试直接API调用\ncurl -X POST http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/chat-messages \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"query\":\"test\"}'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n1. **使用代理**: 前端通过后端代理调用API\n2. **CORS配置**: 检查后端CORS中间件\n3. **URL配置**: 确保API URL指向代理地址\n4. **头部设置**: 检查请求头配置\n\n### 4. 超时错误\n\n#### 问题现象\n- &#96;Request timeout after 30000ms&#96;\n- &#96;fetchError: Request timeout&#96;\n- API调用超时\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# API 契约文档\n\n本文档描述了 Todify3 前后端统一的 API 契约规范。\n\n## 统一响应格式\n\n所有 API 响应遵循以下统一格式：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface ApiResponse&lt;T = unknown&gt; {\n  success: boolean;\n  data?: T;\n  error?: ApiErrorPayload;\n  message?: string;\n}\n\ninterface ApiErrorPayload {\n  code: string;\n  message: string;\n  details?: unknown;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 成功响应示例\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"data\": {\n    \"id\": \"123\",\n    \"name\": \"示例数据\"\n  },\n  \"message\": \"操作成功\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 错误响应示例\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": false,\n  \"error\": {\n    \"code\": \"VALIDATION_ERROR\",\n    \"message\": \"请求参数验证失败\",\n    \"details\": {\n      \"errors\": [\n        {\n          \"field\": \"query\",\n          \"message\": \"Query parameter is required\",\n          \"value\": null\n        }\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 标准错误代码\n\n| 错误代码 | 说明 | HTTP 状态码 |\n|---------|------|------------|\n| &#96;VALIDATION_ERROR&#96; | 请求参数验证失败 | 400 |\n| &#96;UNAUTHORIZED&#96; | 未授权 | 401 |\n| &#96;FORBIDDEN&#96; | 禁止访问 | 403 |\n| &#96;NOT_FOUND&#96; | 资源不存在 | 404 |\n| &#96;DIFY_CHAT_ERROR&#96; | Dify 聊天服务调用失败 | 500 |\n| &#96;DIFY_WORKFLOW_ERROR&#96; | Dify 工作流服务调用失败 | 500 |\n| &#96;AI_SEARCH_FAILED&#96; | AI 搜索执行失败 | 500 |\n| &#96;WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED&#96; | 工作流执行失败 | 500 |\n| &#96;INTERNAL_ERROR&#96; | 服务器内部错误 | 500 |\n\n## 分页响应格式\n\n对于列表接口，使用分页响应格式：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface PaginatedResponse&lt;T&gt; extends ApiResponse&lt;T[]&gt; {\n  meta?: {\n    page: number;\n    pageSize: number;\n    total: number;\n    totalPages: number;\n  };\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 验证错误响应\n\n当请求参数验证失败时，返回详细的验证错误：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface ValidationErrorResponse extends ApiResponse&lt;never&gt; {\n  error: {\n    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR';\n    message: '请求参数验证失败';",

        "contents": "/**\n * AI角色服务\n */\nclass AIRoleService {\n  /**\n   * 获取所有AI角色\n   */\n  async getAIRoles(): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get('/ai-roles');\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        return response.data.data.map((role: any) =&gt; ({\n          ...role,\n          createdAt: new Date(role.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(role.updatedAt),\n        }));\n      }\n      return [];\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\n      \n      // 对于404、500错误或连接错误（后端未运行），静默处理，不输出任何日志\n      // 这是正常情况，不需要记录\n      if (errorStatus === 404 || errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        // 静默失败，返回空数组\n        return [];\n      }\n      \n      // 其他错误才输出详细信息\n      const errorMessage = error?.response?.data?.message || error?.message || '未知错误';\n      const errorUrl = error?.config?.url || error?.request?.responseURL;\n      const errorBaseURL = error?.config?.baseURL;\n      console.error('🔴 [aiRoleService] 获取AI角色列表失败');\n      console.error('错误消息:', errorMessage);\n      console.error('HTTP状态码:', errorStatus);\n      console.error('请求URL:', errorUrl);\n      console.error('Base URL:', errorBaseURL);\n      \n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取单个AI角色\n   */\n  async getAIRole(id: string): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig | null&gt; {\n    try\n  }",

        "contents": "const AIRoleManagementPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 加载角色列表\n  const loadRoles = async () =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const roleList = await aiRoleService.getAIRoles();\n      // 去重：基于ID去除重复的角色\n      const uniqueRoles = Array.from(\n        new Map(roleList.map(role =&gt; [role.id, role])).values()\n      );\n      setRoles(uniqueRoles);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      const errorMessage = error?.response?.data?.message || error?.message || '未知错误';\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status;\n      \n      const errorCode = error?.code;\n      \n      // 对于404、500错误或连接错误（后端未运行），静默处理，不输出控制台错误\n      // 只在UI上显示友好的提示消息\n      if (errorStatus === 404 || errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        // 不输出控制台日志，只显示UI提示\n        setMessage({ \n          type: 'error', \n          text: '后端API未找到，请检查后端服务器是否运行在3003端口'\n        });\n      } else {\n        // 其他错误才输出控制台日志\n        console.error('🔵 [AIRoleManagementPage] 加载AI角色列表失败');\n        console.error('错误消息:', errorMessage);\n        console.error('HTTP状态码:', errorStatus);\n        console.error('请求URL:', error?.config?.url || error?.response?.config?.url);\n        \n        // 区分错误类型，给出更友好的提示\n        let errorText = '';\n        if (errorStatus === 0 || errorStatus === 'ECONNREFUSED') {\n          errorText = '无法连接到后端服务器，请确认后端服务已启动';\n        } else {\n          errorText = &#96;加载AI角色列表失败: ${errorMessage}&#96;;\n        }\n        \n        setMessage({ \n          type: 'error', \n          text: errorText\n        });\n      }\n      \n      // 即使后端失败，也尝试显示localStorage中的配置\n      const configs = migrationService.getLocalStorageConfigs();\n      if (configs.smartWorkflowConfigs.length &gt; 0 || configs.independentPageConfigs.length &gt; 0) {\n        setLocalStorageConfigs(configs);\n      }\n    }\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class DifyGateway {\n\n\n  async executeChat(input: ChatInput): Promise&lt;Result&lt;ChatOutput&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await this.retry(() =&gt;\n        this.chatClient.post('/chat-messages', {\n          query: input.query,\n          conversation_id: input.conversationId,\n          inputs: input.inputs ?? {},\n          response_mode: 'blocking',\n          user: input.userId ?? 'todify-user',\n          files: [],\n        })\n      );\n\n      return success({\n        conversationId: response.data?.conversation_id,\n        messageId: response.data?.message_id,\n        answer: response.data?.answer,\n        raw: response.data,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      const axiosError = error as any;\n      const errorDetails = {\n        message: axiosError.message || (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)),\n        code: axiosError.code,\n        status: axiosError.response?.status,\n        statusText: axiosError.response?.statusText,\n        responseData: axiosError.response?.data,\n        requestUrl: axiosError.config?.url,\n        requestBaseURL: axiosError.config?.baseURL,\n        fullUrl: axiosError.config?.baseURL ? &#96;${axiosError.config.baseURL}${axiosError.config.url}&#96; : axiosError.config?.url,\n        errno: axiosError.errno,\n        syscall: axiosError.syscall,\n        address: axiosError.address,\n        port: axiosError.port,\n      };\n      logger.error('Dify executeChat 失败', { error: errorDetails, input });\n      console.error('Dify executeChat 详细错误:', JSON.stringify(errorDetails, null, 2));\n      \n      // 构建详细的错误消息\n      let errorMessage = errorDetails.message;\n      if (errorDetails.code) {\n        errorMessage += &#96; (${errorDetails.code})&#96;;\n      }\n      if (errorDetails.status) {\n        errorMessage += &#96; [HTTP ${errorDetails.status}]&#96;;\n      }\n      if (errorDetails.responseData) {\n        errorMessage += &#96;: ${JSON.stringify(errorDetails.responseData)}&#96;;\n      }\n      \n      return failure({\n        code: 'DIFY_CHAT_ERROR',\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// Dify工作流代理\nrouter.post('/workflows/run', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Workflow Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    // 直接使用正确的Dify工作流API端点\n    const difyWorkflowUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/workflows/run';\n    console.log('Dify workflow URL:', difyWorkflowUrl);\n\n    const difyResponse = await axios.post(\n      difyWorkflowUrl,\n      { \n        ...requestBody, \n        user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n        response_mode: 'blocking' \n      },\n      {\n        headers: {\n          'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${apiKey}&#96;,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        timeout: 60000,\n      }\n    );\n    \n    console.log('Dify workflow response received:', difyResponse.status);\n    res.json(difyResponse.data);\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('Dify workflow proxy error:', error.message);\n    console.error('Error details:', error.response?.data);\n    res.status(error.response?.status || 500).json({\n      error: error.response?.data || error.message\n    });\n  }\n});\n\nexport default router;",

        "contents": "import type { ApiResponse, ApiErrorPayload } from '@/shared/types/api';\n\nclass ApiClient {\n  private readonly client: AxiosInstance;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.client = axios.create({\n      baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1',\n      timeout: 120_000, // 增加到120秒（2分钟），适应AI请求的较长响应时间\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.request.use((config) =&gt; {\n      const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');\n      if (token) {\n        config.headers = {\n          ...config.headers,\n          Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${token}&#96;,\n        };\n      }\n      return config;\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\n      (response) =&gt; response,\n      (error) =&gt; {\n        // 处理超时错误\n        if (error.code === 'ECONNABORTED' || error.message?.includes('timeout')) {\n          const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n            code: 'TIMEOUT_ERROR',\n            message: '请求超时，请稍后重试。AI处理可能需要较长时间，请耐心等待。',\n            details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n          };\n          return Promise.reject(apiError);\n        }\n\n        const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n          code: error.response?.data?.error?.code || 'API_ERROR',\n          message: error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message || '请求失败',\n          details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n        };\n\n        return Promise.reject(apiError);\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  private unwrap&lt;T&gt;(response: AxiosResponse&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt;): ApiResponse&lt;T&gt; {\n    \n  }",

          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 196
          }
        },
        "contents": "#### 问题现象\n- &#96;Request timeout after 30000ms&#96;\n- &#96;fetchError: Request timeout&#96;\n- API调用超时\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 测试Dify服务响应时间\ntime curl -X POST http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/chat-messages \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"query\":\"test\"}'\n\n# 检查网络连接\nping 47.113.225.93\ntelnet 47.113.225.93 9999\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n1. **增加超时时间**: 调整前端超时设置\n2. **网络优化**: 检查网络连接质量\n3. **服务优化**: 优化Dify服务性能\n4. **重试机制**: 实现请求重试\n\n## 🔧 配置问题解决\n\n### 1. 环境变量问题\n\n#### 常见错误\n- &#96;PORT is not defined&#96;\n- &#96;API key is missing&#96;\n- &#96;Database connection failed&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查环境变量文件\ncat /root/todify2-deploy/backend/.env\n\n# 重新加载环境变量\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/backend\nsource .env\nnpm run dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 数据库问题\n\n#### 常见错误\n- &#96;SQLITE_ERROR: no such table&#96;\n- &#96;Database connection failed&#96;\n- &#96;Permission denied&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查数据库文件\nls -la /root/todify2-deploy/backend/data/\n\n# 重新创建数据库表\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/backend\nnpx ts-node src/scripts/create-workflow-stats-tables.ts\n\n# 检查文件权限\nchmod 644 /root/todify2-deploy/backend/data/todify3.db\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Nginx配置问题\n\n#### 常见错误\n- &#96;nginx: configuration file test failed&#96;\n- &#96;502 Bad Gateway&#96;\n- &#96;504 Gateway Timeout&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 测试Nginx配置\nnginx -t\n\n# 检查配置文件\ncat /etc/nginx/sites-available/todify2\n\n# 重载Nginx配置\nsystemctl reload nginx\n\n# 检查Nginx日志\ntail -f /var/log/nginx/error.log\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📊 性能问题解决\n\n### 1. 响应慢\n\n#### 诊断方法\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查服务响应时间\ncurl -w \"@curl-format.txt\" -o /dev/null -s http://47.113.225.93:8088/api/health\n\n# 检查系统资源\ntop\nfree -h\ndf -h\n\n# 检查网络延迟\nping 47.113.225.93\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 优化方案\n1. **前端优化**: 启用压缩、缓存\n2. **后端优化**: 优化数据库查询\n3. **网络优化**: 使用CDN、优化路由",

null : chatResult.error \n        });\n        \n        if (!chatResult.success) {\n          // 提取错误信息\n          const errorObj = chatResult.error || {};\n          const errorDetails = typeof errorObj.details === 'string' ?                   "lineNumber": 9148,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n  }\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 10187,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Settings,\\n  User,\\n  ChevronDown,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\n];\\n\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\n  '/ai-roles',\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\n  '/ai-management',\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('用户');\\n  \\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\n      if (username) {\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\n        try {\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\n        } catch {\\n          return username;\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\n    }\\n    // 默认返回\\\"用户\\\"\\n    return '用户';\\n  };\\n  \\n  // 初始化用户名\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    \\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    \\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = (event?: Event) =&amp;gt; {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到配置更新事件:', event);\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = (event?: Event) =&amp;gt; {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到自定义刷新事件:', event);\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 重新计算 mainItems，activeConfigs:', activeConfigs.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 找到配置 ${navItem.name}:&amp;#96;, config);\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 未找到配置 ${navItem.name}，将显示为禁用状态&amp;#96;);\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 生成的 mainItems:', items.map(i =&amp;gt; ({ id: i.id, label: i.label, disabled: i.disabled })));\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 创建公开页面配置\\\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.post('/', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 验证必填字段\\\\n    if (!name) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'name',\\\\n        message: '配置名称不能为空'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 如果没有提供displayMode，使用默认值'role'\\\\n    const finalDisplayMode = displayMode || 'role';\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证显示模式\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(finalDisplayMode)) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证workflow模式\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !workflowId) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'workflowId',\\\\n        message: '工作流模式下必须提供workflowId'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证custom模式\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (!roleIds || !Array.isArray(roleIds) || roleIds.length === 0)) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'roleIds',\\\\n        message: '自定义模式下必须提供角色ID列表'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证role模式（如果没有提供roleIds，使用空数组）\\\\n    // 注意：role模式允许空数组，表示显示所有角色\\\\n    \\\\n    const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\n      name,\\\\n      description,\\\\n      address,\\\\n      displayMode: finalDisplayMode,\\\\n      workflowId,\\\\n      roleIds: roleIds || (finalDisplayMode === 'role' ? [] : undefined),\\\\n      templateType,\\\\n      customHtml,\\\\n      isActive: req.body.isActive, // 支持创建时设置isActive\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, newConfig, '创建配置成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('创建配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '创建配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 更新公开页面配置\\\\n * PUT /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.put('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, isActive, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证显示模式\\\\n    if (displayMode &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(displayMode)) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\n      name,\\\\n      description,\\\\n      address,\\\\n      displayMode,\\\\n      workflowId,\\\\n      roleIds,\\\\n      isActive,\\\\n      templateType,\\\\n      customHtml,\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '更新配置成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('更新配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '更新配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 删除公开页面配置\\\\n * DELETE /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.delete('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    await publicPageConfigModel.delete(id);\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, null, '删除配置成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('删除配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '删除配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 预览配置（获取角色列表）\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/preview\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.get('/:id/preview', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\n    \\\\n    if (!config) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\\\n    \\\\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\\\n      // 获取所有启用的角色\\\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; config.roleIds &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      // 获取指定的角色\\\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; r.enabled);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, { roles, config }, '获取配置预览成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('获取配置预览失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '获取配置预览失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 导入独立页面配置\\\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs/import-independent-pages\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.post('/import-independent-pages', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; c.name === (nodeMapping[role.id]?.name || role.name)\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        if (existing) {\\\\n          importResults.push({\\\\n            role,\\\\n            config: existing,\\\\n            status: 'exists'\\\\n          });\\\\n          continue;\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // 创建新配置\\\\n        const nodeInfo = nodeMapping[role.id] || {\\\\n          name: role.name,\\\\n          description: &amp;amp;#96;${role.description}公开页面&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n        };\\\\n\\\\n        const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\n          name: nodeInfo.name,\\\\n          description: nodeInfo.description,\\\\n          displayMode: 'custom',\\\\n          roleIds: [role.id],\\\\n        };\\\\n\\\\n        const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\\\n        importResults.push({\\\\n          role,\\\\n          config: newConfig,\\\\n          status: 'created'\\\\n        });\\\\n      } catch (error) {\\\\n        importResults.push({\\\\n          role,\\\\n          config: null,\\\\n          status: 'error',\\\\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const createdCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; r.status === 'created').length;\\\\n    const existsCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; r.status === 'exists').length;\\\\n    const errorCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; r.status === 'error').length;\\\\n\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, {\\\\n      results: importResults,\\\\n      summary: {\\\\n        total: independentPageRoles.length,\\\\n        created: createdCount,\\\\n        exists: existsCount,\\\\n        errors: errorCount\\\\n      }\\\\n    }, &amp;amp;#96;导入完成：创建${createdCount}个，已存在${existsCount}个，失败${errorCount}个&amp;amp;#96;));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('导入独立页面配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '导入独立页面配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 根据地址获取配置\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/by-address/:address\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.get('/by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt;                   "lineNumber": 1599,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport {\\\\n  MessageCircle,\\\\n  Target,\\\\n  FileText,\\\\n  Mic,\\\\n  Home,\\\\n  Settings,\\\\n  User,\\\\n  ChevronDown,\\\\n} from \\\\\\\"lucide-react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  label: string;\\\\n  icon: any;\\\\n  path: string;\\\\n  disabled: boolean;\\\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\\\n  configId?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\\\n  '/ai-roles',\\\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\\\n  '/ai-management',\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt;('用户');\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    \\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      navigate(path);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\\\n    if (path === '/') {\\\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\\\n    }\\\\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\\\\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\\\\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&amp;amp;gt; \\\\n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\\\\n      );\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 精确匹配\\\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return (\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n\\\\n          return (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\\\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\\\n                  ${\\\\n                    item.disabled\\\\n                      ? \\\\\\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                      : isCurrent\\\\n                        ? \\\\\\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"\\\\n                        : \\\\\\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                  }\\\\n                &amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n                title={item.label}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;amp;#96;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                \\\\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport {\\\\n  MessageCircle,\\\\n  Target,\\\\n  FileText,\\\\n  Mic,\\\\n  Home,\\\\n  Bot,\\\\n  Workflow,\\\\n  MessageSquare,\\\\n  Layers,\\\\n} from \\\\\\\"lucide-react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  label: string;\\\\n  icon: any;\\\\n  path: string;\\\\n  disabled: boolean;\\\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\\\n  configId?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    navigate(path);\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\\\n    if (path === '/') {\\\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 精确匹配\\\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return (\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n\\\\n          return (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\\\n                  ${\\\\n                    item.disabled\\\\n                      ? \\\\\\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                      : isCurrent\\\\n                        ? \\\\\\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"\\\\n                        : \\\\\\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                  }\\\\n                &amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n                title={item.label}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;amp;#96;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                \\\\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                )}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          );\\\\n        })}\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    );\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  return (\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          \\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;h1 className=\\\\\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;/h1&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          )}\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\\\n          {loading &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"ml-4 flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          )}\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  );\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\\\n\\\",\""

                  "lineNumber": 1869,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"# Todify3 数据库设计文档 v2.0\\n\\n## 一、概述\\n\\n本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的统一数据库架构设计，整合了所有分散的表定义，解决了表结构冲突，并规范化了命名和数据类型。\\n\\n### 1.1 设计目标\\n\\n- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护\\n- **性能优化**：优化索引和查询，提升数据库性能\\n- **数据完整性**：完善外键约束，保障数据一致性\\n- **可扩展性**：规范化设计，便于后续扩展\\n- **向后兼容**：保持与现有代码的兼容性\\n\\n### 1.2 架构分层\\n\\n数据库架构分为五层：\\n\\n1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据\\n2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系\\n3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）\\n4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息\\n5. **第五层：配置与统计层** - AI角色配置、页面配置、文件管理、统计分析\\n\\n## 二、表结构设计\\n\\n### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层\\n\\n#### 2.1.1 品牌表 (brands)\\n\\n存储汽车品牌信息。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |\\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\\n| logo_url | TEXT | Logo URL |\\n| country | TEXT | 国家 |\\n| founded_year | INTEGER | 成立年份 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| status | TEXT | 状态：active/inactive |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.1.2 车型表 (car_models)\\n\\n存储车型信息，关联品牌。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| brand_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联brands.id |\\n| name | TEXT | 车型名称 |\\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\\n| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\\n\\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\\n\\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\\n\\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\\n\\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\\n\\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\\n\\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\\n| application_status | VARCHAR(50) | 应用状态 |\\n| implementation_date | DATE | 实施日期 |\\n| notes | TEXT | 备注 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n**唯一约束**：(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\n\\n### 2.3 第三层：AI内容生成层\\n\\n#### 2.3.1 知识点表 (knowledge_points)\\n\\n存储从AI搜索等来源获取的知识点。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| title | TEXT | 标题 |\\n| content | TEXT | 内容 |\\n| source_query | TEXT | 来源查询 |\\n| source_url | TEXT | 来源URL |\\n| source_type | TEXT | 来源类型：ai_search/manual/import |\\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON格式的元数据 |\\n| tags | TEXT | JSON格式的标签 |\\n| relevance_score | REAL | 相关度分数 |\\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\\n| dify_task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\\n| |\\n| name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| version | TEXT | 版本号（默认'1.0.0'） |\\n| nodes | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点列表 |\\n| edges | TEXT | JSON字符串，连接边列表 |\\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON字符串，元数据 |\\n| published | INTEGER | 是否已发布（0/1） |\\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMP | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.4.2 工作流执行表 (workflow_executions) - 执行类型：'agent_workflow' 或 'dify_workflow' |\\n| workflow_id | TEXT | Agent工作流ID（外键，agent_workflows.id） |\\n| workflow_name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\\n| shared_context | TEXT | JSON字符串，共享上下文（Agent工作流） |\\n| node_results | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点执行结果（Agent工作流） |\\n| workflow_run_id | TEXT | Dify工作流运行ID（唯一） |\\n| task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\\n| message_id | TEXT | 关联消息ID（外键，chat_messages.message_id） |\\n| app_type | TEXT | 应用类型（Dify工作流） |\\n| status | TEXT | 执行状态 |\\n| error_message | TEXT | 错误信息 |\\n| inputs | TEXT | JSON格式的输入 |\\n| outputs | TEXT | JSON格式的输出 |\\n| elapsed_time | REAL | 执行时间（秒） |\\n| total_tokens | INTEGER | 总token数 |\\n| total_steps | INTEGER | 总步数 |\\n| duration | INTEGER | 持续时间（毫秒，Agent工作流） |\\n| start_time | TIMESTAMP | 开始时间 |\\n| end_time | TIMESTAMP | 结束时间 |\\n| started_at | (conversations)\\n\\n存储对话会话信息。\\n\\n#### 2.4.4 聊天消息表 (chat_messages)\\n\\n存储聊天消息，关联对话会话。\\n\\n### 2.5 第五层：配置与统计层\\n\\n#### 2.5.1 AI角色表 (ai_roles)\\n\\n存储AI角色配置。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\\n| name | TEXT | 角色名称 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| avatar | TEXT | 头像URL |\\n| system_prompt | TEXT | 系统提示词 |\\n| dify_config | TEXT | JSON字符串，Dify配置 |\\n| enabled | INTEGER | 是否启用（0/1） |\\n| source | TEXT | 来源标记 |\\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMP | 更新时间 |\\n\\n**dify_config JSON结构**：\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;json\\n{\\n  \\\"apiUrl\\\": \\\"string\\\",\\n  \\\"apiKey\\\": \\\"string\\\",\\n  \\\"connectionType\\\": \\\"chatflow\\\" | \\\"workflow\\\",\\n  \\\"inputFields\\\": [...]\\n}\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### 2.5.2 公开页面配置表 (public_page_configs)\\n\\n存储公开页面配置。\\n\\n#### 2.5.3 页面工具配置表 (page_tool_configs)\\n\\n存储页面工具配置，按页面类型唯一。\\n\\n#### 2.5.4 文件表 (files)\\n\\n存储上传的文件信息。\\n\\n#### 2.5.5 统计表\\n\\n- **workflow_node_usage** - 工作流节点使用统计\\n- **ai_qa_feedback** - AI问答评价统计\\n- **workflow_session_stats** - 工作流会话统计\\n- **node_content_processing** - 节点内容处理统计\\n- **workflow_stats_summary** - 实时统计汇总\\n\\n## 三、关键设计决策\\n\\n### 3.1 workflow_executions表统一\\n\\n**问题**：原有两个不同的&amp;#96;workflow_executions&amp;#96;表定义：\\n1. Agent工作流执行表（TEXT主键，包含shared_context、node_results等）\\n2. Dify工作流执行表（INTEGER主键，包含workflow_run_id、task_id等）\\n\\n**解决方案**：\\n- 合并为统一表，使用TEXT主键\\n- 添加&amp;#96;execution_type&amp;#96;字段区分类型\\n- 包含两种类型的所有字段，根据类型使用相应字段\\n\\n### 3.2 主键类型规范\\n\\n- **核心业务表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT（brands, car_models, tech_points等）\\n- **配置表**：使用TEXT（UUID或自定义ID）（ai_roles, agent_workflows等）\\n- **关联表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT\\n\\n### 3.3 命名规范\\n\\n- **表名**：使用复数形式（tech_points而非tech_point）\\n- **字段名**：统一使用snake_case\\n- **索引名**：统一格式&amp;#96;idx_表名_字段名&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3.4 JSON字段存储\\n\\n复杂配置数据以JSON字符串存储：\\n- &amp;#96;dify_config&amp;#96; - Dify配置\\n- &amp;#96;nodes&amp;#96;、&amp;#96;edges&amp;#96; - 工作流结构\\n- &amp;#96;metadata&amp;#96; - 元数据\\n- &amp;#96;tags&amp;#96;、&amp;#96;keywords&amp;#96; - 数组数据\\n\\n## 四、索引设计\\n\\n### 4.1 索引策略\\n\\n1. **主键索引**：自动创建\\n2. **外键索引**：为所有外键字段创建索引\\n3. **查询索引**：为常用查询字段创建索引\\n4. **复合索引**：为多字段组合查询创建复合索引\\n\\n### 4.2 重要索引\\n\\n- &amp;#96;idx_workflow_executions_type&amp;#96; - 按执行类型查询\\n- &amp;#96;idx_workflow_executions_type_status&amp;#96; - 按类型和状态查询\\n- &amp;#96;idx_tech_points_category_status&amp;#96; - 按分类和状态查询\\n- &amp;#96;idx_chat_messages_conv_status&amp;#96; - 按对话和状态查询\\n\\n## 五、数据迁移\\n\\n### 5.1 迁移机制\\n\\n使用&amp;#96;database_migrations&amp;#96;表记录所有迁移历史：\\n- migration_name: 迁移文件名\\n- version: 版本号\\n- executed_at: 执行时间\\n- execution_time_ms: 执行耗时\\n- status: 执行状态\\n- error_message: 错误信息\\n\\n### 5.2 迁移工具\\n\\n使用&amp;#96;migrate.ts&amp;#96;工具执行迁移：\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\nts-node backend/src/scripts/migrate.ts\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 六、使用说明\\n\\n### 6.1 初始化数据库\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\n# SQLite\\nDB_TYPE=sqlite DB_PATH=./database.db ./backend/src/scripts/init-database-v2.sh\\n\\n# PostgreSQL\\nDB_TYPE=postgresql PGHOST=localhost PGDATABASE=todify2 PGUSER=postgres ./backend/src/scripts/init-database-v2.sh\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 6.2 执行迁移\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\nts-node backend/src/scripts/migrate.ts\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 6.3 查看迁移状态\\n\\n迁移工具会自动记录执行状态到&amp;#96;database_migrations&amp;#96;表。\\n\\n## 七、注意事项\\n\\n1. **向后兼容**：新架构保持与现有代码的兼容性\\n2. **数据备份**：执行迁移前必须备份现有数据\\n3. **测试验证**：在测试环境充分验证新架构\\n4. **性能测试**：验证索引优化后的查询性能\\n5. **文档更新**：同步更新API文档和开发文档\\n\\n## 八、版本历史\\n\\n- **v2.0** (2025-01-XX): 统一数据库架构，解决表冲突，规范化命名\\n- **v1.0**: 初始分散的数据库架构\\n\\n\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"-- Todify3 统一数据库架构 v2.0\\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\\n-- 说明: 整合所有表定义，统一命名规范，解决表结构冲突\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第一层：基础数据层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 品牌表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\\n    name_en TEXT,\\n    logo_url TEXT,\\n    country TEXT,\\n    founded_year INTEGER,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 车型表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    name_en TEXT,\\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 车系表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\\n    description TEXT,\\n    launch_year INTEGER,\\n    end_year INTEGER,\\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    metadata TEXT,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术分类表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    category_id INTEGER,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF DEFAULT 'planned',\\n    implementation_date DATE,\\n    notes TEXT,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\\n);\\n\\n-- ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\\n    relevance_score REAL,\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\\n    created_by INTEGER,\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n JSON格式存储生成参数\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术推广策略表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_promotion_strategies (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    strategy_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\n    target_market VARCHAR(255),\\n    timeline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储时间线\\n    budget_range VARCHAR(100),\\n    kpi_metrics TEXT, -- JSON格式存储KPI指标\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术通稿表\\nCREATE TABLE release_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\n    target_media TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\n    publication_date DATE,\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\\n    seo_keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    published_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术演讲稿表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    title JSON格式存储生成参数\\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    delivered_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 推广策略与技术点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promotion_tech_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    promotion_id INTEGER NOT tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    UNIQUE(promotion_id, tech_point_id)\\n);\\n\\n-- 通稿与技术点关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_tech_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    press_release_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n    weight description TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    category TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    thumbnail TEXT,\\n    workflow_structure TEXT NOT NULL,  -- JSON字符串，存储工作流结构\\n    metadata TEXT,                     -- JSON字符串，元数据\\n CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 统一的工作流执行表（合并Agent工作流和Dify工作流执行记录）\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions (\\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\\n    execution_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (execution_type IN ('agent_workflow', 'dify_workflow')),\\n    \\n    -- Agent工作流执行字段\\n    workflow_id TEXT,                  -- 关联agent_workflows.id\\n    workflow_name TEXT,\\n    shared_context TEXT DEFAULT '{}',  -- JSON字符串，共享上下文\\n    node_results TEXT DEFAULT '[]',    -- JSON字符串，节点执行结果列表\\n    \\n    -- Dify工作流执行字段\\n    workflow_run_id TEXT UNIQUE,       -- Dify工作流运行ID\\n    task_id TEXT,   });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Create project error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\\n\\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\\n\\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\\n\\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\\n\\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\\n\\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\\n\\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\\n\\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\\n\\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\\n|--------|------|------|\\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 5637,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# 三层级车系架构设计\\n\\n## 概述\\n将原有的两层级结构（品牌-车系）调整为三层级结构（品牌-车型-车系），以更好地反映汽车行业的实际层级关系。\\n\\n## 层级关系\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n品牌 (Brand)\\n├── 车型 (Model) \\n    ├── 车系 (Series)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 数据库设计\\n\\n### 1. 品牌表 (brands)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\nCREATE TABLE brands (\\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2. 车型表 (car_models)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\\n);\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3. 车系表 (car_series)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 6244,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    category_id INTEGER,\\n    parent_id INTEGER,\\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- ==============================================\\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\\n-- ==============================================\\n\\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\","
                }

error.message : String(error),\\n            });\\n            // 即使转换失败，也继续上传文件\\n          }\\n\\n          // 构建metadata，包含pageType和markdown内容\\n          const metadata: any = pageType ? { pageType } : {};\\n          if (markdownContent) {\\n            metadata.markdownContent = markdownContent;\\n          }\\n\\n          const fileRecord = await fileService.createFile({\\n            original_name: originalName,\\n            stored_name: file.filename,\\n            file_path: filePath,\\n            file_url: fileUrl,\\n            mime_type: file.mimetype,\\n            file_size: file.size,\\n            category,\\n            conversation_id: conversationId || undefined,\\n            uploader_id: uploaderId || undefined,\\n            metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length &amp;gt; 0 ?
