                  "lineNumber": 6649,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * 发送消息\\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\\n */\\nrouter.post(\\n  '/conversations/:id/messages',\\n  ensureTablesInitialized,\\n  upload.array('files', 10),\\n  async (req: Request, res: Response) =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const { id } = req.params;\\n      let sourcesValue = req.body.sources;\\n      if (typeof sourcesValue === 'string') {\\n        try {\\n          sourcesValue = JSON.parse(sourcesValue);\\n        } catch (parseError) {\\n          logger.warn('解析sources失败，使用原始值', { parseError });\\n          sourcesValue = undefined;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      const body = {\\n        content: req.body.content,\\n        sources: Array.isArray(sourcesValue) ? sourcesValue : undefined,\\n        contextWindowSize: req.body.contextWindowSize,\\n        workflowId: req.body.workflowId,\\n        fileList: req.body.fileList,\\n        knowledgeBaseNames: req.body.knowledgeBaseNames,\\n      };\\n      const files = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\\n\\n      const dto = validateDTO(SendMessageSchema, body);\\n      const result = await sendMessageUseCase.execute({\\n        conversationId: id,\\n        content: dto.content,\\n        sources: dto.sources,\\n        files,\\n        contextWindowSize: typeof dto.contextWindowSize === 'number' ? dto.contextWindowSize : (dto.contextWindowSize ? parseInt(String(dto.contextWindowSize), 10) : undefined),\\n        workflowId: dto.workflowId,\\n        fileList: dto.fileList,\\n        knowledgeBaseNames: dto.knowledgeBaseNames,\\n      });\\n\\n      if (!result.success) {\\n        return res.status(500).json(\\n          formatApiResponse(false, null, '发送消息失败', result.error.message)\\n        );\\n      }\\n\\n      res.json(\\n        formatApiResponse(\\n          true,\\n          result.value,\\n          result.value.error ? '发送消息成功，但工作流执行失败' : '发送消息成功'\\n        )\\n      );\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      if (error instanceof ValidationException) {\\n        const failure = formatValidationFailure(error);\\n  }\","

                  "lineNumber": 8460,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';\\nimport { SourceInformationService } from '../services/sourceInformationService';\\nimport { CreateSourceInformationDTO, UpdateSourceInformationDTO } from '../types/database';\\n\\nconst router = Router();\\nconst sourceInformationService = new SourceInformationService();\\n\\n// 初始化数据库表（可选，通常在应用启动时调用）\\nrouter.post('/init', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\\n    res.json({\\n      success: true,\\n      message: '来源信息表初始化成功'\\n    });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('初始化来源信息表失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: '初始化来源信息表失败',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 创建来源信息\\nrouter.post('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const data: CreateSourceInformationDTO = req.body;\\n    \\n    // 验证必填字段\\n    if (!data.source_id || !data.title || !data.type) {\\n      return res.status(400).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: 'source_id、title和type为必填字段'\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 验证type字段\\n    if (!['knowledge_base', 'external'].includes(data.type)) {\\n      return res.status(400).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: 'type必须是knowledge_base或external'\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    const sourceInformation = await sourceInformationService.createSourceInformation(data);\\n    \\n    res.status(201).json({\\n      success: true,\\n      data: sourceInformation,\\n      message: '来源信息创建成功'\\n    });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('创建来源信息失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: '创建来源信息失败',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 批量创建来源信息\\nrouter.post('/batch', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const dataList: CreateSourceInformationDTO[] = req.body;\\n    \\n    if (!Array.isArray(dataList) || dataList.length === 0) {\\n      return res.status(400).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: '请提供有效的来源信息数组'\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 验证每个数据项\\n    for (const data of dataList) {\\n      if (!data.source_id || !data.title || !data.type) {\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '每个来源信息必须包含source_id、title和type字段'\\n        });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const results = await sourceInformationService.createSourceInformationBatch(dataList);\\n    \\n    res.status(201).json({\\n      success: true,\\n      data: results,\\n      message: &amp;#96;成功创建${results.length}条来源信息&amp;#96;\\n    });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('批量创建来源信息失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: '批量创建来源信息失败',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 获取来源信息列表（必须在参数路由之前）\\nrouter.get('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const page = parseInt(req.query.page as string) || 1;\\n    const pageSize = parseInt(req.query.pageSize as string) || 20;\\n    const orderBy = req.query.orderBy as string || 'created_at';\\n    const orderDirection = (req.query.orderDirection as string || 'DESC').toUpperCase();\\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string;\\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string;\\n    const type = req.query.type as string;\\n    const status = req.query.status as string || 'active';\\n\\n    const where: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {};\\n    if (pageType) where.page_type = pageType;\\n    if (conversationId) where.conversation_id = conversationId;\\n    if (type) where.type = type;\\n    if (status) where.status = status;\\n\\n    const options = {\\n      limit: pageSize,\\n      offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,\\n      orderBy,\\n      orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\\n      where: Object.keys(where).length &amp;gt; 0 ?                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import express from 'express';\\nimport { formatApiResponse, formatValidationErrorResponse } from '../utils/validation';\\nimport { publicPageConfigModel, agentWorkflowModel, aiRoleModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreatePublicPageConfigDTO, UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO } from '../models/PublicPageConfig';\\n\\nconst router = express.Router();\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取所有公开页面配置\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs\\n */\\nrouter.get('/', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const configs = await publicPageConfigModel.getAll();\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, configs, '获取配置列表成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置列表失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置列表失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取单个配置\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\n */\\nrouter.get('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\","

                  "lineNumber": 12630,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import express from 'express';\\nimport { formatApiResponse, formatValidationErrorResponse } from '../utils/validation';\\nimport { publicPageConfigModel, agentWorkflowModel, aiRoleModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreatePublicPageConfigDTO, UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO } from '../models/PublicPageConfig';\\n\\nconst router = express.Router();\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取所有公开页面配置\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs\\n */\\nrouter.get('/', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const configs = await publicPageConfigModel.getAll();\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, configs, '获取配置列表成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置列表失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置列表失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取单个配置\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\n */\\nrouter.get('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建公开页面配置\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs\\n */\\nrouter.post('/', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\n    \\n    // 验证必填字段\\n    if (!name) {\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\n        field: 'name',\\n        message: '配置名称不能为空'\\n      }]));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 如果没有提供displayMode，使用默认值'role'\\n    const finalDisplayMode = displayMode || 'role';\\n\\n    // 验证显示模式\\n    if (finalDisplayMode &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(finalDisplayMode)) {\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\n      }]));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 验证workflow模式\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !workflowId) {\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\n        field: 'workflowId',\\n        message: '工作流模式下必须提供workflowId'\\n      }]));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 验证custom模式\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (!roleIds || !Array.isArray(roleIds) || roleIds.length === 0)) {\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\n        field: 'roleIds',\\n        message: '自定义模式下必须提供角色ID列表'\\n      }]));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 验证role模式（如果没有提供roleIds，使用空数组）\\n    // 注意：role模式允许空数组，表示显示所有角色\\n    \\n    const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\n      name,\\n      description,\\n      address,\\n      displayMode: finalDisplayMode,\\n      workflowId,\\n      roleIds: roleIds || (finalDisplayMode === 'role' ? [] : undefined),\\n      templateType,\\n      customHtml,\\n      isActive: req.body.isActive, // 支持创建时设置isActive\\n    };\\n    \\n    const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, newConfig, '创建配置成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('创建配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '创建配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 更新公开页面配置\\n * PUT /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\n */\\nrouter.put('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, isActive, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\n    \\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 验证显示模式\\n    if (displayMode &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(displayMode)) {\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\n      }]));\\n    }\\n\\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\n      name,\\n      description,\\n      address,\\n      displayMode,\\n      workflowId,\\n      roleIds,\\n      isActive,\\n      templateType,\\n      customHtml,\\n    };\\n    \\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '更新配置成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('更新配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '更新配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 删除公开页面配置\\n * DELETE /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\n */\\nrouter.delete('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    \\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n    \\n    await publicPageConfigModel.delete(id);\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, null, '删除配置成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('删除配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '删除配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 预览配置（获取角色列表）\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/preview\\n */\\nrouter.get('/:id/preview', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\n      // 获取所有启用的角色\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      // 获取指定的角色\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, { roles, config }, '获取配置预览成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置预览失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置预览失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 导入独立页面配置\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs/import-independent-pages\\n */\\nrouter.post('/import-independent-pages', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    // 获取所有独立页面角色\\n    const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n    const independentPageRoles = allRoles.filter(\\n      r =&amp;gt; r.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled\\n    );\\n\\n    if (independentPageRoles.length === 0) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(\\n        false,\\n        null,\\n        '未找到独立页面角色，请先初始化独立页面AI角色'\\n      ));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 定义节点映射\\n    const nodeMapping: Record&amp;lt;string, { name: string; config: any; status: 'created' | 'exists' | 'error'; error?: string }&amp;gt; = [];\\n\\n    // 为每个独立页面角色创建公开页面配置\\n    for (const role of independentPageRoles) {\\n      try {\\n        // 检查是否已存在配置（通过名称匹配）\\n        const existingConfigs = await publicPageConfigModel.getAll();\\n        const existing = existingConfigs.find(\\n          c =&amp;gt; c.name === (nodeMapping[role.id]?.name || role.name)\\n        );\\n\\n        if (existing) {\\n          importResults.push({\\n            role,\\n            config: existing,\\n            status: 'exists'\\n          });\\n          continue;\\n        }\\n\\n        // 创建新配置\\n        const nodeInfo = nodeMapping[role.id] || {\\n          name: role.name,\\n          description: &amp;#96;${role.description}公开页面&amp;#96;\\n        };\\n\\n        const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\n          name: nodeInfo.name,\\n          description: nodeInfo.description,\\n          displayMode: 'custom',\\n          roleIds: [role.id],\\n        };\\n\\n        const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\n        importResults.push({\\n          role,\\n          config: newConfig,\\n          status: 'created'\\n        });\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        importResults.push({\\n          role,\\n          config: null,\\n          status: 'error',\\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n        });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const createdCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.status === 'created').length;\\n    const existsCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.status === 'exists').length;\\n    const errorCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.status === 'error').length;\\n\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, {\\n      results: importResults,\\n      summary: {\\n        total: independentPageRoles.length,\\n        created: createdCount,\\n        exists: existsCount,\\n        errors: errorCount\\n      }\\n    }, &amp;#96;导入完成：创建${createdCount}个，已存在${existsCount}个，失败${errorCount}个&amp;#96;));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('导入独立页面配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '导入独立页面配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 根据地址获取配置\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/by-address/:address\\n */\\nrouter.get('/by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const { isActive } = req.body;\\n\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n\\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\n      isActive: typeof isActive === 'boolean' ? isActive : !existingConfig.isActive,\\n    };\\n\\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\\n\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '切换状态成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('切换状态失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '切换状态失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\nexport default router;\\n\\n\","

                  "lineNumber": 13042,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n  \\n  // 初始化用户名\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    \\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    \\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n  }\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 18360,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Settings,\\n  User,\\n  ChevronDown,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\n];\\n\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\n  '/ai-roles',\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\n  '/ai-management',\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('用户');\\n  \\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\n      if (username) {\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\n        try {\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\n        } catch {\\n          return username;\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\n    }\\n    // 默认返回\\\"用户\\\"\\n    return '用户';\\n  };\\n  \\n  // 初始化用户名\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    \\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    \\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\n    } else {\\n      navigate(path);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\n    } else {\\n      navigate(path);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&amp;gt; \\n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\\n      );\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16 justify-between\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 左侧导航项 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 第一组：项目管理 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            \\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\\n            &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\\n            &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 第三组：Agent配置 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 右侧：加载状态和用户标识 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n            {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;div className=\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            )}\\n\\n            {/* 用户标识 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-200\\\"\\n                title=\\\"用户\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;User className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;用户&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\n\","

DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- 2. 车型车系表\\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT COMMENT '是否启用',\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\\n);\\n\\n-- 3. 技术点表\\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT {\\n  try {\\n    const { token } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAccessToken(token);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取角色列表\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\\n      context: { metadata: { token: req.params.token } },\\n    });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\\n      data: null\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 公开访问接口（通过address获取配置和角色）\\napp.get('/api/v1/public-by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; {\\n  res.json({ \\n    message: 'Todify3 Backend API',\\n    version: '1.0.0',\\n    status: 'running',\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n    uptime: process.uptime(),\\n  });\\n});\\n\\n// 性能监控 API\\napp.get('/api/v1/monitoring/performance', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    res.set('Content-Type', 'text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8');\\n    const metrics = await prometheusMetrics.getMetrics();\\n    res.send(metrics);\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));\\n    res.status(500).send('# Error generating metrics\\\\n');\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 生产环境静态文件服务：直接从 frontend/dist 提供资源\\n// 注意：必须在 API 路由之后，否则会拦截 API 请求\\n// 仅在非开发环境或明确需要时才启用静态文件服务\\nconst isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';\\nif (!isDev) {\\n  const distDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../frontend/dist');\\n  app.use(express.static(distDir, {\\n    maxAge: 0,\\n    etag: true,\\n    lastModified: true,\\n  }));\\n\\n  // SPA Fallback：除 /api/* 外的所有路由都返回 index.html\\n  app.get(/^(\\\\/(?!api).*)$/, (_req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n      logger.info('Backend server 已启动', { url: &amp;#96;http://0.0.0.0:${port}&amp;#96; });\\n    });\\n\\n    // 保持进程运行\\n    server.keepAliveTimeout = 0;\\n    server.headersTimeout = 0;\\n\\n    // 优雅关闭处理\\n    process.on('SIGTERM', () =&amp;gt; {\\n      logger.info('SIGINT received, shutting down gracefully');\\n      server.close(() =&amp;gt; {\\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\\n        process.exit(0);\\n      });\\n    });\\n\\n    return server;\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\\n      level: 'fatal',\\n    });\\n    logger.error('Failed to start server', { error });\\n    process.exit(1);\\n  }\\n}\\n\\nstartServer();\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { Request, Response } from 'express';\\nimport { techCategoryModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreateTechCategoryDTO, UpdateTechCategoryDTO } from '../types/database';\\n\\nexport class TechCategoryController {\\n  /**\\n   * 创建技术分类\\n   */\\n  async create(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const data: CreateTechCategoryDTO = req.body;\\n      const category = await techCategoryModel.create(data);\\n      res.status(201).json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: category,\\n        message: '技术分类创建成功'\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Create tech category error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '创建技术分类失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术分类详情\\n   */\\n  async getById(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      const category = await techCategoryModel.findById(id);\\n      if (!category) {\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: category\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Get tech category error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: '获取技术分类失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术分类列表\\n   */\\n  async getAll(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const {\\n        page = 1,\\n        pageSize = 20,\\n        orderBy = 'sort_order',\\n        orderDirection = 'ASC',\\n        status,\\n        parent_id\\n      } = req.query;\\n\\n      const options = {\\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string),\\n        orderBy: orderBy as string,\\n        orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\\n        where: {} as any\\n      };\\n\\n      if (status) {\\n        options.where.status = status;\\n      }\\n\\n      if (parent_id !== undefined) {\\n        options.where.parent_id = parent_id === 'null' ? null : parseInt(parent_id as string);\\n      }\\n\\n      const result = await techCategoryModel.findAll(options);\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: result\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Get tech categories error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: '获取技术分类列表失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取技术分类树结构\\n   */\\n  async getTree(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const tree = await techCategoryModel.getTree();\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: tree\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Get tech category tree error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: '获取技术分类树失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新技术分类\\n   */\\n  async update(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      const data: UpdateTechCategoryDTO = req.body;\\n      const category = await techCategoryModel.update(id, data);\\n      \\n      if (!category) {\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: category,\\n        message: '技术分类更新成功'\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Update tech category error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '更新技术分类失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除技术分类\\n   */\\n  async delete(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      const success = await techCategoryModel.delete(id);\\n      if (!success) {\\n        return res.status(404).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '技术分类不存在'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        message: '技术分类删除成功'\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Delete tech category error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '删除技术分类失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 搜索技术分类\\n   */\\n  async search(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const { keyword, page = 1, pageSize = 20 } = req.query;\\n      \\n      if (!keyword) {\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '搜索关键词不能为空'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      const options = {\\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string)\\n      };\\n\\n      const result = await techCategoryModel.search(keyword as string, options);\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        data: result\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Search tech categories error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: '搜索技术分类失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 批量更新排序\\n   */\\n  async updateSortOrder(req: Request, res: Response) {\\n    try {\\n      const { items } = req.body;\\n      \\n      if (!Array.isArray(items)) {\\n        return res.status(400).json({\\n          success: false,\\n          message: '无效的排序数据'\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      await techCategoryModel.updateSortOrder(items);\\n      res.json({\\n        success: true,\\n        message: '排序更新成功'\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('Update sort order error:', error);\\n      res.status(500).json({\\n        success: false,\\n        message: '更新排序失败'\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\","

{\\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n    params: req.params,\\n    query: req.query,\\n    body: req.body,\\n  });\\n  next();\\n});\\n\\n// 注册路由\\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\\nrouter.use('/projects', projectsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\\n\\n// 健康检查\\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Bot,\\n  Workflow,\\n  MessageSquare,\\n  Layers,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    navigate(path);\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          \\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\n                &amp;lt;/h1&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n          {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"ml-4 flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\n\","

{\\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n    params: req.params,\\n    query: req.query,\\n    body: req.body,\\n  });\\n  next();\\n});\\n\\n// 注册路由\\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\\n\\n// 健康检查\\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\n    headers: req.headers,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    url: req.url,\\n  });\\n  try {\\n    const response = {\\n      success: true,\\n      message: 'API is running',\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\n    };\\n    res.json(response);\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 简单测试端点\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('Test endpoint called');\\n  res.json({\\n    success: true,\\n    message: 'Test endpoint working',\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\\n  });\\n});\\n\\n// 404 处理中间件（必须在所有路由之后）\\nrouter.use((req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.warn('API 路由未找到', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n  });\\n  res.status(404).json({\\n    success: false,\\n    error: {\\n      code: 'NOT_FOUND',\\n      message: &amp;#96;路由不存在: ${req.method} ${req.path}&amp;#96;,\\n    },\\n  });\\n});\\n\\nexport default router;\","

                  "lineNumber": 527,
                  "content": "  &amp;quot;plan&amp;quot;: &amp;quot;# 新增独立的AI Agent配置（完整Agent能力）\\n\\n## 核心目标\\n构建完整的独立AI Agent系统，不依赖Dify，支持：\\n1. **高级Prompt管理**：System Prompt + 动态变量 + 模板\\n2. **上下文管理策略**：历史消息窗口、摘要压缩、Token控制\\n3. **工具调用能力**：Function Calling集成（搜索、计算、API调用等）\\n4. **Agent协作**：调用其他Agent或Workflow\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 1. 类型定义与数据模型\\n\\n### Frontend (&amp;#96;frontend/src/types/aiRole.ts&amp;#96;)\\n\\n扩展 &amp;#96;AIRoleConfig&amp;#96;：\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nexport interface AIRoleConfig {\\n  id: string;\\n  name: string;\\n  description: string;\\n  avatar?: string;\\n  \\n  // Provider配置（Dify 或 Direct Agent）\\n  provider: &amp;#39;dify&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;direct-agent&amp;#39;;\\n  \\n  // Dify配置（保持现有）\\n  difyConfig?: DifyConfig;\\n  \\n  // Direct Agent配置（新增）\\n  agentConfig?: DirectAgentConfig;\\n  \\n  enabled: boolean;\\n  source?: string;\\n  createdAt: Date;\\n  updatedAt: Date;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface DirectAgentConfig {\\n  // LLM基础配置\\n  llm: {\\n    provider: &amp;#39;openai&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;azure-openai&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;qwen&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;ernie&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;custom&amp;#39;;\\n    apiKey: string;\\n    apiBaseUrl?: string;  // 自定义端点\\n    model: string;        // gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, qwen-max等\\n    temperature: number;  // 0-2\\n    maxTokens: number;    // 最大生成token数\\n    topP?: number;        // 0-1\\n  };\\n  \\n  // Prompt配置\\n  prompt: {\\n    systemPrompt: string;           // 系统提示词\\n    variables?: PromptVariable[];   // 动态变量\\n    templates?: PromptTemplate[];   // 预设模板\\n  };\\n  \\n  // 上下文管理策略\\n  contextStrategy: {\\n    type: &amp;#39;window&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;summary&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;hybrid&amp;#39;;  // 窗口/摘要/混合\\n    maxMessages: number;                     // 最大历史消息数\\n    maxTokens: number;                       // 最大上下文token数\\n    summaryThreshold?: number;               // 触发摘要的消息数阈值\\n    includeSystemPrompt: boolean;            // 是否每次都包含system prompt\\n  };\\n  \\n  // 工具调用配置\\n  tools?: ToolConfig[];\\n  \\n  // Agent协作配置\\n  agentCalls?: AgentCallConfig[];\\n}\\n\\n// Prompt变量定义\\nexport interface PromptVariable {\\n  name: string;           // 变量名，如 {{user_name}}\\n  description: string;    // 变量说明\\n  type: &amp;#39;static&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;dynamic&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;context&amp;#39;;  // 静态/动态/上下文\\n  value?: string;         // 静态值\\n  source?: string;        // 动态来源（如：user.profile.name）\\n}\\n\\n// Prompt模板\\nexport interface PromptTemplate {\\n  id: string;\\n  name: string;\\n  content: string;\\n  variables: string[];    // 需要的变量列表\\n}\\n\\n// 工具配置\\nexport interface ToolConfig {\\n  id: string;\\n  name: string;           // 工具名称（function name）\\n  description: string;    // 工具描述\\n  type: &amp;#39;search&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;api&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;calculation&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;workflow&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;custom&amp;#39;;\\n  enabled: boolean;\\n  parameters: ToolParameter[];  // 参数定义（JSON Schema格式）\\n  implementation?: {\\n    endpoint?: string;    // API端点\\n    method?: string;      // HTTP方法\\n    headers?: Record&amp;lt;string, string&amp;gt;;\\n    workflowId?: string;  // 关联的workflow ID\\n  };\\n}\\n\\nexport interface ToolParameter {\\n  name: string;\\n  type: &amp;#39;string&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;number&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;boolean&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;array&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;object&amp;#39;;\\n  description: string;\\n  required: boolean;\\n  enum?: string[];        // 枚举值\\n  default?: any;\\n}\\n\\n// Agent调用配置\\nexport interface AgentCallConfig {\\n  id: string;\\n  targetAgentId?: string;      // 目标Agent ID\\n  targetWorkflowId?: string;   // 目标Workflow ID\\n  name: string;                // 调用名称\\n  description: string;         // 调用描述\\n  trigger: &amp;#39;manual&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;auto&amp;#39;;  // 手动/自动触发\\n  inputMapping?: Record&amp;lt;string, string&amp;gt;;   // 输入映射\\n  outputMapping?: Record&amp;lt;string, string&amp;gt;;  // 输出映射\\n}\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Backend (&amp;#96;backend/src/models/AIRole.ts&amp;#96;)\\n- 同步更新接口定义\\n- &amp;#96;dify_config&amp;#96; 字段改为更通用的 &amp;#96;config&amp;#96; JSON存储\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 2. 后端核心服务实现\\n\\n### 2.1 LLM Provider抽象层 (&amp;#96;backend/src/services/llm/LLMProvider.ts&amp;#96;)\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n// 抽象接口\\nexport interface ILLMProvider {\\n  chat(messages: ChatMessage[], config: LLMConfig, tools?: Tool[]): Promise&amp;lt;LLMResponse&amp;gt;;\\n  testConnection(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt;;\\n}\\n\\n// 统一消息格式\\nexport interface ChatMessage {\\n  role: &amp;#39;system&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;user&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;assistant&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;tool&amp;#39;;\\n  content: string;\\n  name?: string;        // tool调用时的函数名\\n  tool_call_id?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 统一响应格式\\nexport interface LLMResponse {\\n  content: string;\\n  toolCalls?: ToolCall[];  // Function calling结果\\n  usage: {\\n    promptTokens: number;\\n    completionTokens: number;\\n    totalTokens: number;\\n  };\\n  model: string;\\n  finishReason: &amp;#39;stop&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;length&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;tool_calls&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;content_filter&amp;#39;;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface ToolCall {\\n  id: string;\\n  type: &amp;#39;function&amp;#39;;\\n  function: {\\n    name: string;\\n    arguments: string;  // JSON字符串\\n  };\\n}\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2.2 具体Provider实现\\n\\n#### &amp;#96;OpenAIProvider.ts&amp;#96;\\n- 标准OpenAI API调用\\n- 支持Function Calling\\n- 错误处理和重试\\n\\n#### &amp;#96;AzureOpenAIProvider.ts&amp;#96;\\n- Azure特定的端点格式\\n- API版本管理\\n\\n#### &amp;#96;CustomProvider.ts&amp;#96;\\n- 通用OpenAI兼容端点\\n- 支持国产大模型（通义千问、文心一言等）\\n\\n### 2.3 上下文管理服务 (&amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ContextManager.ts&amp;#96;)\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nexport class ContextManager {\\n  // 获取上下文消息\\n  async getContextMessages(\\n    conversationId: string,\\n    strategy: ContextStrategy,\\n    currentQuery: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;gt; {\\n    const history = await ChatMessageService.getConversationMessages(conversationId);\\n    \\n    switch (strategy.type) {\\n      case &amp;#39;window&amp;#39;:\\n        return this.applyWindowStrategy(history, strategy);\\n      case &amp;#39;summary&amp;#39;:\\n        return await this.applySummaryStrategy(history, strategy);\\n      case &amp;#39;hybrid&amp;#39;:\\n        return await this.applyHybridStrategy(history, strategy);\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 窗口策略：保留最近N条消息\\n  private applyWindowStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): ChatMessage[] {\\n    return history.slice(-strategy.maxMessages).map(toMessage);\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 摘要策略：旧消息压缩为摘要\\n  private async applySummaryStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): Promise&amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;gt; {\\n    if (history.length &amp;lt;= strategy.summaryThreshold!) {\\n      return history.map(toMessage);\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 将旧消息发送给LLM生成摘要\\n    const oldMessages = history.slice(0, -strategy.maxMessages);\\n    const summary = await this.generateSummary(oldMessages);\\n    const recentMessages = history.slice(-strategy.maxMessages);\\n    \\n    return [\\n      { role: &amp;#39;system&amp;#39;, content: &amp;#96;对话摘要：${summary}&amp;#96; },\\n      ...recentMessages.map(toMessage)\\n    ];\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 混合策略：结合窗口和摘要\\n  private async applyHybridStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): Promise&amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;gt; {\\n    // Token计数 + 智能截断\\n    const messages = [];\\n    let tokenCount = 0;\\n    \\n    for (let i = history.length - 1; i &amp;gt;= 0; i--) {\\n      const msg = history[i];\\n      const msgTokens = this.estimateTokens(msg.content);\\n      \\n      if (tokenCount + msgTokens &amp;gt; strategy.maxTokens) {\\n        // 超过限制，对剩余消息生成摘要\\n        if (i &amp;gt; 0) {\\n          const summary = await this.generateSummary(history.slice(0, i));\\n          messages.unshift({ role: &amp;#39;system&amp;#39;, content: &amp;#96;历史摘要：${summary}&amp;#96; });\\n        }\\n        break;\\n      }\\n      \\n      messages.unshift(toMessage(msg));\\n      tokenCount += msgTokens;\\n    }\\n    \\n    return messages;\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 生成摘要\\n  private async generateSummary(messages: any[]): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    // 调用LLM生成对话摘要\\n    // 使用简单的prompt：\\&amp;quot;请总结以下对话的关键信息...\\&amp;quot;\\n  }\\n  \\n  // Token估算（简单实现：1 token ≈ 4 chars）\\n  private estimateTokens(text: string): number {\\n    return Math.ceil(text.length / 4);\\n  }\\n}\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2.4 Prompt管理服务 (&amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/PromptManager.ts&amp;#96;)\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nexport class PromptManager {\\n  // 渲染Prompt（替换变量）\\n  renderPrompt(\\n    template: string,\\n    variables: PromptVariable[],\\n    context: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;\\n  ): string {\\n    let rendered = template;\\n    \\n    for (const variable of variables) {\\n      const value = this.resolveVariable(variable, context);\\n      rendered = rendered.replace(new RegExp(&amp;#96;{{${variable.name}}}&amp;#96;, &amp;#39;g&amp;#39;), value);\\n    }\\n    \\n    return rendered;\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 解析变量值\\n  private resolveVariable(variable: PromptVariable, context: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;): string {\\n    switch (variable.type) {\\n      case &amp;#39;static&amp;#39;:\\n        return variable.value || &amp;#39;&amp;#39;;\\n      case &amp;#39;dynamic&amp;#39;:\\n        return this.getNestedValue(context, variable.source || &amp;#39;&amp;#39;);\\n      case &amp;#39;context&amp;#39;:\\n        return context[variable.name] || &amp;#39;&amp;#39;;\\n      default:\\n        return &amp;#39;&amp;#39;;\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 获取嵌套属性值（如：user.profile.name）\\n  private getNestedValue(obj: any, path: string): string {\\n    return path.split(&amp;#39;.&amp;#39;).reduce((acc, part) =&amp;gt; acc?.[part], obj) || &amp;#39;&amp;#39;;\\n  }\\n}\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2.5 工具执行服务 (&amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;#96;)\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nexport class ToolExecutor {\\n  // 执行工具调用\\n  async executeTool(toolCall: ToolCall, toolConfig: ToolConfig): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    const args = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments);\\n    \\n    switch (toolConfig.type) {\\n      case &amp;#39;search&amp;#39;:\\n        return await this.executeSearch(args);\\n      case &amp;#39;api&amp;#39;:\\n        return await this.executeAPI(toolConfig, args);\\n      case &amp;#39;workflow&amp;#39;:\\n        return await this.executeWorkflow(toolConfig.implementation!.workflowId!, args);\\n      case &amp;#39;calculation&amp;#39;:\\n        return this.executeCalculation(args);\\n      default:\\n        throw new Error(&amp;#96;不支持的工具类型: ${toolConfig.type}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 搜索工具\\n  private async executeSearch(args: any): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    // 调用搜索API或知识库\\n    // 返回搜索结果\\n  }\\n  \\n  // API调用工具\\n  private async executeAPI(config: ToolConfig, args: any): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    const response = await axios({\\n      method: config.implementation!.method || &amp;#39;POST&amp;#39;,\\n      url: config.implementation!.endpoint!,\\n      headers: config.implementation!.headers,\\n      data: args\\n    });\\n    return JSON.stringify(response.data);\\n  }\\n  \\n  // Workflow调用工具\\n  private async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, args: any): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    const result = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(workflowId, args);\\n    return JSON.stringify(result);\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 计算工具\\n  private executeCalculation(args: any): string {\\n    // 安全的数学表达式计算\\n    // 使用沙箱环境执行\\n  }\\n}\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2.6 Agent编排服务 (&amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&amp;#96;)\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nexport class AgentOrchestrator {\\n  // 执行Agent（核心方法）\\n  async executeAgent(\\n    roleId: string,\\n    query: string,\\n    conversationId: string,\\n    context: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {}\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;gt; {\\n    // 1. 获取Agent配置\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\n    if (!role || !role.agentConfig) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#39;Agent配置不存在&amp;#39;);\\n    }\\n    \\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\\n    \\n    // 2. 渲染System Prompt\\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\\n      context\\n    );\\n    \\n    // 3. 获取上下文消息\\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\\n      conversationId,\\n      config.contextStrategy,\\n      query\\n    );\\n    \\n    // 4. 构建完整消息列表\\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [\\n      { role: &amp;#39;system&amp;#39;, content: systemPrompt },\\n      ...contextMessages,\\n      { role: &amp;#39;user&amp;#39;, content: query }\\n    ];\\n    \\n    // 5. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\\n    \\n    // 6. 调用LLM\\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\\n    let response = await provider.chat(messages, config.llm, tools);\\n    \\n    // 7. 处理工具调用（如果有）\\n    while (response.toolCalls &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.toolCalls.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const toolResults = await this.executeTools(response.toolCalls, config.tools || []);\\n      \\n      // 将工具调用和结果添加到消息历史\\n      messages.push({ role: &amp;#39;assistant&amp;#39;, content: response.content || &amp;#39;&amp;#39; });\\n      for (const result of toolResults) {\\n        messages.push({\\n          role: &amp;#39;tool&amp;#39;,\\n          content: result.content,\\n          name: result.toolName,\\n          tool_call_id: result.toolCallId\\n        });\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 再次调用LLM处理工具结果\\n      response = await provider.chat(messages, config.llm, tools);\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 8. 保存消息历史\\n    await this.saveMessages(conversationId, query, response, roleId);\\n    \\n    // 9. 返回结果\\n    return {\\n      content: response.content,\\n      usage: response.usage,\\n      conversationId\\n    };\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 执行多个工具调用\\n  private async executeTools(toolCalls: ToolCall[], toolConfigs: ToolConfig[]) {\\n    const results = [];\\n    for (const toolCall of toolCalls) {\\n      const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&amp;gt; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\\n      if (!config) {\\n        results.push({\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: &amp;#39;工具不存在&amp;#39; })\\n        });\\n        continue;\\n      }\\n      \\n      try {\\n        const result = await this.toolExecutor.executeTool(toolCall, config);\\n        results.push({\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\n          content: result\\n        });\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        results.push({\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: error.message })\\n        });\\n      }\\n    }\\n    return results;\\n  }\\n}\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 3. 前端UI实现\\n\\n### 3.1 修改 &amp;#96;AIRoleManagementPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### Provider选择区\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;tsx\\n&amp;lt;div className=\\&amp;quot;provider-selector\\&amp;quot;&amp;gt;\\n  &amp;lt;label&amp;gt;Agent类型&amp;lt;/label&amp;gt;\\n  &amp;lt;div className=\\&amp;quot;radio-group\\&amp;quot;&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;input type=\\&amp;quot;radio\\&amp;quot; value=\\&amp;quot;dify\\&amp;quot; checked={provider === &amp;#39;dify&amp;#39;} /&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;label&amp;gt;Dify工作流&amp;lt;/label&amp;gt;\\n    \\n    &amp;lt;input type=\\&amp;quot;radio\\&amp;quot; value=\\&amp;quot;direct-agent\\&amp;quot; checked={provider === &amp;#39;direct-agent&amp;#39;} /&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;label&amp;gt;独立Agent&amp;lt;/label&amp;gt;\\n  &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### Direct Agent配置表单（分Tab展示）\\n\\n**Tab 1: LLM基础配置**\\n- Provider下拉选择（OpenAI / Azure OpenAI / 通义千问 / 文心一言 / 自定义）\\n- Model选择（根据Provider显示预设模型）\\n- API Key输入\\n- API Base URL（自定义端点时显示）\\n- Temperature滑块（0-2）\\n- Max Tokens输入框\\n\\n**Tab 2: Prompt配置**\\n- System Prompt多行文本框（支持Markdown）\\n- 变量管理：\\n  - 添加变量按钮\\n  - 变量列表（名称、类型、值/来源）\\n  - 变量预览（显示渲染后的Prompt）\\n- 模板库：预设常用Prompt模板（客服、翻译、代码助手等）\\n\\n**Tab 3: 上下文策略**\\n- 策略类型选择（窗口/摘要/混合）\\n- 最大消息数滑块\\n- 最大Token数输入\\n- 摘要阈值（摘要模式时显示）\\n- 包含System Prompt开关\\n\\n**Tab 4: 工具配置**\\n- 工具列表\\n- 添加工具按钮：\\n  - 工具类型选择（搜索/API/计算/Workflow）\\n  - 工具名称和描述\\n  - 参数定义（JSON Schema编辑器）\\n  - 实现配置（API端点、Workflow ID等）\\n- 启用/禁用工具开关\\n\\n**Tab 5: Agent协作**\\n- Agent调用列表\\n- 添加调用按钮：\\n  - 目标Agent/Workflow选择\\n  - 调用名称和描述\\n  - 触发方式（手动/自动）\\n  - 输入/输出映射配置\\n\\n### 3.2 创建独立组件\\n\\n#### &amp;#96;PromptEditor.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 富文本编辑器\\n- 变量插入快捷方式\\n- 实时预览\\n\\n#### &amp;#96;ToolConfigEditor.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- JSON Schema可视化编辑器\\n- 参数类型选择器\\n- 测试工具调用功能\\n\\n#### &amp;#96;ContextStrategySelector.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 策略类型切换\\n- 参数配置表单\\n- 预估Token消耗展示\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 4. 路由修改\\n\\n### &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/aiRole.ts&amp;#96;\\n\\n修改 &amp;#96;POST /:id/chat&amp;#96; 端点：\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nrouter.post(&amp;#39;/:id/chat&amp;#39;, async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { id } = req.params;\\n  const { query, conversationId = &amp;#39;&amp;#39;, context = {} } = req.body;\\n  \\n  const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(id);\\n  if (!role || !role.enabled) {\\n    return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, &amp;#39;AI角色不存在或已禁用&amp;#39;));\\n  }\\n  \\n  try {\\n    let result;\\n    \\n    if (role.provider === &amp;#39;dify&amp;#39;) {\\n      // 现有Dify逻辑\\n      result = await DifyClient.aiSearch(query, context, conversationId);\\n    } else if (role.provider === &amp;#39;direct-agent&amp;#39;) {\\n      // 新的Direct Agent逻辑\\n      result = await agentOrchestrator.executeAgent(id, query, conversationId, context);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, result, &amp;#39;对话成功&amp;#39;));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, &amp;#39;对话失败&amp;#39;, error.message));\\n  }\\n});\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 5. 预设工具库\\n\\n### 内置工具实现\\n\\n#### 1. **搜索工具** (&amp;#96;search&amp;#96;)\\n- 调用现有的AI Search功能\\n- 参数：&amp;#96;query&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;limit&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### 2. **计算工具** (&amp;#96;calculate&amp;#96;)\\n- 安全的数学表达式计算\\n- 参数：&amp;#96;expression&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### 3. **Workflow调用工具** (&amp;#96;call_workflow&amp;#96;)\\n- 调用指定的Agent Workflow\\n- 参数：&amp;#96;workflow_id&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;inputs&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### 4. (&amp;#96;frontend/src/types/aiRole.ts&amp;#96;)\\n\\n扩展 &amp;#96;AIRoleConfig&amp;#96;：\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nexport interface AIRoleConfig {\\n  id: string;\\n  name: difyConfig?: DifyConfig;\\n  \\n  // Direct Agent配置（新增）\\n  agentConfig?: DirectAgentConfig;\\n  \\n  enabled: boolean;\\n  source?: string;\\n  createdAt: Date;\\n  updatedAt: Date;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface DirectAgentConfig {\\n  // LLM基础配置\\n  llm: {\\n    provider: &amp;#39;openai&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;azure-openai&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;qwen&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;ernie&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;custom&amp;#39;;\\n    apiKey: string;\\n    apiBaseUrl?: string;  // 自定义端点\\n    model: string;        // gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, qwen-max等\\n    temperature: number;  // 0-2\\n    maxTokens: number;    // 最大生成token数\\n    topP?: number;        // 0-1\\n  };\\n  \\n  // Prompt配置\\n  prompt: {\\n    systemPrompt: string;           // 系统提示词\\n    variables?: PromptVariable[];   // 动态变量\\n    templates?: PromptTemplate[];   // 预设模板\\n  };\\n  \\n  // 上下文管理策略\\n  contextStrategy: {\\n    type: &amp;#39;window&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;summary&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;hybrid&amp;#39;;  // 窗口/摘要/混合\\n    maxMessages: number;                     // 最大历史消息数\\n    maxTokens: number;                       // 最大上下文token数\\n    summaryThreshold?: number;               // 触发摘要的消息数阈值\\n Prompt变量定义\\nexport interface PromptVariable {\\n  name: string;           // 变量名，如 {{user_name}}\\n  description: string;    // 变量说明\\n  type: &amp;#39;static&amp;#39; | &amp;#39;dynamic&amp;#39; | id: string;\\n  type: &amp;#39;function&amp;#39;;\\n  function: {\\n    name: string;\\n    arguments: string;  // JSON字符串\\n  };\\n}\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2.2 具体Provider实现\\n\\n####
