(&amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ContextManager.ts&amp;#96;)\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nexport class ContextManager {\\n  // 获取上下文消息\\n  async getContextMessages(\\n    conversationId: string,\\n    strategy: ContextStrategy,\\n    currentQuery: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;gt; {\\n    const history = await ChatMessageService.getConversationMessages(conversationId);\\n    \\n    switch (strategy.type) {\\n      case &amp;#39;window&amp;#39;:\\n        return this.applyWindowStrategy(history, strategy);\\n      case &amp;#39;summary&amp;#39;:\\n        return await this.applySummaryStrategy(history, strategy);\\n      case &amp;#39;hybrid&amp;#39;:\\n        return await this.applyHybridStrategy(history, strategy);\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 窗口策略：保留最近N条消息\\n  private applyWindowStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): ChatMessage[] {\\n    return history.slice(-strategy.maxMessages).map(toMessage);\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 摘要策略：旧消息压缩为摘要\\n  private async applySummaryStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): Promise&amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;gt; {\\n    if (history.length &amp;lt;= strategy.summaryThreshold!) {\\n      return history.map(toMessage);\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 将旧消息发送给LLM生成摘要\\n    const oldMessages = history.slice(0, -strategy.maxMessages);\\n    const summary = await this.generateSummary(oldMessages);\\n    const recentMessages = history.slice(-strategy.maxMessages);\\n    \\n    return [\\n      { role: &amp;#39;system&amp;#39;, content: &amp;#96;对话摘要：${summary}&amp;#96; },\\n      ...recentMessages.map(toMessage)\\n    ];\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 混合策略：结合窗口和摘要\\n  private async applyHybridStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): Promise&amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;gt; {\\n    // Token计数 + 智能截断\\n    const messages = [];\\n    let tokenCount = 0;\\n    \\n    for (let i = history.length - 1; i &amp;gt;= 0; i--) {\\n      const msg = history[i];\\n      const msgTokens = this.estimateTokens(msg.content);\\n      \\n      if (tokenCount + msgTokens &amp;gt; strategy.maxTokens) {\\n        // 超过限制，对剩余消息生成摘要\\n        if (i &amp;gt; 0) {\\n          const summary = await this.generateSummary(history.slice(0, i));\\n          messages.unshift({ role: &amp;#39;system&amp;#39;, content: &amp;#96;历史摘要：${summary}&amp;#96; });\\n        }\\n        break;\\n      }\\n      \\n      messages.unshift(toMessage(msg));\\n      tokenCount += msgTokens;\\n    }\\n    \\n    return messages;\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 生成摘要\\n  private async generateSummary(messages: any[]): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    // 调用LLM生成对话摘要\\n    // 使用简单的prompt：\\&amp;quot;请总结以下对话的关键信息...\\&amp;quot;\\n  }\\n  \\n  // Token估算（简单实现：1 token ≈ 4 chars）\\n  private estimateTokens(text: string): number {\\n    return Math.ceil(text.length / 4);\\n  }\\n}\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2.4 Prompt管理服务 (&amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/PromptManager.ts&amp;#96;)\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nexport class PromptManager {\\n  // 渲染Prompt（替换变量）\\n  renderPrompt(\\n    template: string,\\n    variables: PromptVariable[],\\n    context: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;\\n  ): string {\\n    let rendered = template;\\n    \\n    for (const variable of variables) {\\n      const value = this.resolveVariable(variable, context);\\n      rendered = rendered.replace(new RegExp(&amp;#96;{{${variable.name}}}&amp;#96;, &amp;#39;g&amp;#39;), value);\\n    }\\n    \\n    return rendered;\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 解析变量值\\n  private resolveVariable(variable: PromptVariable, context: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;): string {\\n    switch (variable.type) {\\n      case &amp;#39;static&amp;#39;:\\n        return variable.value || &amp;#39;&amp;#39;;\\n      case &amp;#39;dynamic&amp;#39;:\\n        return this.getNestedValue(context, variable.source || &amp;#39;&amp;#39;);\\n      case &amp;#39;context&amp;#39;:\\n        return context[variable.name] || &amp;#39;&amp;#39;;\\n      default:\\n        return &amp;#39;&amp;#39;;\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 获取嵌套属性值（如：user.profile.name）\\n  private getNestedValue(obj: any, path: string): string {\\n    return path.split(&amp;#39;.&amp;#39;).reduce((acc, part) =&amp;gt; acc?.[part], obj) || &amp;#39;&amp;#39;;\\n  }\\n}\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2.5 工具执行服务 (&amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;#96;)\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nexport class ToolExecutor {\\n  // 执行工具调用\\n  async executeTool(toolCall: ToolCall,      return await this.executeSearch(args);\\n      case &amp;#39;api&amp;#39;:\\n        return await this.executeAPI(toolConfig, args);\\n      case &amp;#39;workflow&amp;#39;:\\n        return new Error(&amp;#96;不支持的工具类型: ${toolConfig.type}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 搜索工具\\n  private async executeSearch(args: any): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    // 调用搜索API或知识库\\n    // 返回搜索结果\\n  }\\n  \\n  // API调用工具\\n  private async executeAPI(config: ToolConfig, args: any): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    const response = await axios({\\n      method: JSON.stringify(response.data);\\n  }\\n  \\n  // Workflow调用工具\\n  private async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, args: any): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    const result = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(workflowId, args);\\n    return JSON.stringify(result);\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 计算工具\\n  private executeCalculation(args: any): string {\\n    // 安全的数学表达式计算\\n    // 使用沙箱环境执行\\n  }\\n}\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2.6 Agent编排服务 (&amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&amp;#96;)\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nexport class AgentOrchestrator {\\n  // 执行Agent（核心方法）\\n  async executeAgent(\\n    roleId: string,\\n    query: string,\\n    conversationId: string,\\n    context: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {}\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;gt; {\\n    // 1. 获取Agent配置\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\n    if (!role || !role.agentConfig) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#39;Agent配置不存在&amp;#39;);\\n    }\\n    \\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\\n    \\n    // 2. 渲染System Prompt\\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\\n      context\\n    );\\n    \\n    // 3. 获取上下文消息\\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\\n      conversationId,\\n      config.contextStrategy,\\n      query\\n    );\\n    \\n    // 4. 构建完整消息列表\\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [\\n      { role: &amp;#39;system&amp;#39;, content: systemPrompt },\\n      ...contextMessages,\\n      { role: &amp;#39;user&amp;#39;, content: query }\\n    ];\\n    \\n    // 5. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\\n    \\n    // 6. 调用LLM\\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\\n    let response = await provider.chat(messages, config.llm, tools);\\n    \\n    // 7. 处理工具调用（如果有）\\n    while (response.toolCalls &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.toolCalls.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const toolResults = await this.executeTools(response.toolCalls, config.tools || []);\\n      \\n      // 将工具调用和结果添加到消息历史\\n      messages.push({ role: &amp;#39;assistant&amp;#39;, content: response.content || &amp;#39;&amp;#39; });\\n      for (const result of toolResults) {\\n        messages.push({\\n          role: &amp;#39;tool&amp;#39;,\\n          content: result.content,\\n          name: result.toolName,\\n          tool_call_id: result.toolCallId\\n        });\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 再次调用LLM处理工具结果\\n      response = await provider.chat(messages, config.llm, tools);\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 8. 保存消息历史\\n    await this.saveMessages(conversationId, query, response, roleId);\\n    \\n    // 9. 返回结果\\n    return {\\n      content: response.content,\\n      usage: response.usage,\\n      conversationId\\n    };\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 执行多个工具调用\\n  private async executeTools(toolCalls: ToolCall[], toolConfigs: ToolConfig[]) {\\n    const results = [];\\n    for (const toolCall of toolCalls) {\\n      const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&amp;gt; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\\n      if (!config) {\\n        results.push({\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: &amp;#39;工具不存在&amp;#39; })\\n        });\\n        continue;\\n      }\\n      \\n      try {\\n        const result = await this.toolExecutor.executeTool(toolCall, config);\\n        results.push({\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\n          content: result\\n        });\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        results.push({\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: error.message })\\n        });\\n      }\\n    }\\n    return results;\\n /:id/chat&amp;#96; 端点：\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nrouter.post(&amp;#39;/:id/chat&amp;#39;, async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { id } = req.params;\\n  const { query, conversationId = &amp;#39;&amp;#39;, context = {} } = req.body;\\n  \\n  const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(id);\\n  if (!role || !role.enabled) {\\n    return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, &amp;#39;AI角色不存在或已禁用&amp;#39;));\\n  }\\n  \\n  try {\\n    let result;\\n    \\n    if (role.provider === &amp;#39;dify&amp;#39;) {\\n      // 现有Dify逻辑\\n      result = await DifyClient.aiSearch(query, context, conversationId);\\n    } else if (role.provider === &amp;#39;direct-agent&amp;#39;) {\\n      // 新的Direct Agent逻辑\\n      result = await agentOrchestrator.executeAgent(id, query, conversationId, context);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, result, &amp;#39;对话成功&amp;#39;));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, &amp;#39;对话失败&amp;#39;, error.message));\\n  }\\n});\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 5. 预设工具库\\n\\n### 内置工具实现\\n\\n#### 1. **搜索工具**         "contents": "class ErrorTrackingService {\n  private initialized = false;\n  private sentryEnabled = false;\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化错误追踪服务\n   */\n  init() {\n    if (this.initialized) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // 初始化 Sentry（如果配置了 DSN）\n    const sentryDsn = process.env.SENTRY_DSN;\n    if (sentryDsn) {\n      try {\n        Sentry.init({\n          dsn: sentryDsn,\n          environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',\n          tracesSampleRate: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 0.1 : 1.0,\n          beforeSend(event, hint) {\n            // 过滤掉一些不重要的错误\n            if (event.exception) {\n              const error = hint.originalException;\n              if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message.includes('ECONNREFUSED')) {\n                return null; // 忽略连接拒绝错误\n              }\n            }\n            return event;\n          },\n        });\n        this.sentryEnabled = true;\n        logger.info('Sentry 错误追踪已启用');\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('Sentry 初始化失败', { error });\n      }\n    } else {\n      logger.info('Sentry DSN 未配置，使用本地日志记录');\n    }\n\n    // 捕获未处理的异常\n    process.on('uncaughtException', (error) =&gt; {\n      this.captureException(error, {\n        level: 'fatal',\n        tags: { type: 'uncaughtException' },\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 捕获未处理的 Promise 拒绝\n    process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason) =&gt; {\n      this.captureException(\n        reason instanceof Error ? reason : new Error(String(reason)),\n        {\n          level: 'error',\n          tags: { type: 'unhandledRejection' },\n        },\n      );\n    });\n\n    this.initialized = true;\n    logger.info('错误追踪服务已初始化');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 捕获异常\n   */\n  captureException(\n    error: Error,\n    options?: {\n      level?: 'error' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'fatal';\n      context?: ErrorContext;\n      tags?: Record&lt;string, string&gt;;\n    },\n  ) {\n    \n  }",

        "contents": "async function startServer() {\n\n    \n    // 初始化公共知识库数据库表\n    try {\n      const { publicKnowledgeModel } = await import('./models');\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('公共知识库数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('公共知识库数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    const server = app.listen(port, \"0.0.0.0\", () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('Backend server 已启动', { url: &#96;http://0.0.0.0:${port}&#96; });\n    });\n\n    // 保持进程运行\n    server.keepAliveTimeout = 0;\n    server.headersTimeout = 0;\n\n    // 优雅关闭处理\n    process.on('SIGTERM', () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('SIGTERM received, shutting down gracefully');\n      server.close(() =&gt; {\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\n        process.exit(0);\n      });\n    });\n\n    process.on('SIGINT', () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('SIGINT received, shutting down gracefully');\n      server.close(() =&gt; {\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\n        process.exit(0);\n      });\n    });\n\n    return server;\n  } catch (error) {\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\n      level: 'fatal',\n    });\n    logger.error('Failed to start server', { error });\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n}\n\nstartServer();",

        "contents": "// 性能监控中间件（放在最前面）\nif (performanceMonitor &amp;&amp; typeof performanceMonitor.middleware === 'function') {\n  app.use(performanceMonitor.middleware());\n} else {\n  logger.warn('性能监控中间件未正确加载，跳过');\n}\n\n// Prometheus 指标中间件（放在性能监控之后）\nif (prometheusMetrics &amp;&amp; typeof prometheusMetrics.middleware === 'function') {\n  app.use(prometheusMetrics.middleware());\n} else {\n  logger.warn('Prometheus 指标中间件未正确加载，跳过');\n}\n\n// 添加请求日志中间件（放在最前面，但要在路由之前）\napp.use((req, res, next) =&gt; {\n  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();\n  logger.info('收到请求', {\n    timestamp,\n    method: req.method,\n    url: req.url,\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\n    ip: req.ip || req.connection.remoteAddress,\n    userAgent: req.get('User-Agent'),\n    body: req.body,\n    authorization: req.get('Authorization')?.substring(0, 20),\n    contentType: req.get('Content-Type'),\n  });\n  next();\n});\n\n// API 路由必须放在静态文件服务之前\n// 路由配置（API 保持 /api/v1 前缀）\napp.use('/api/v1', apiRoutes);",

        "contents": "class ErrorTrackingService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 捕获异常\n   */\n  captureException(\n    error: Error,\n    options?: {\n      level?: 'error' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'fatal';\n      context?: ErrorContext;\n      tags?: Record&lt;string, string&gt;;\n    },\n  ) {\n    const { level = 'error', context, tags } = options || {};\n\n    // 记录到日志\n    const logLevel = level === 'fatal' ? 'error' : level === 'warning' ? 'warn' : level;\n    logger[logLevel as 'error' | 'warn' | 'info'](error.message, {\n      error: {\n        name: error.name,\n        message: error.message,\n        stack: error.stack,\n      },\n      context,\n      tags,\n    });\n\n    // 发送到 Sentry\n    if (this.sentryEnabled) {\n      Sentry.withScope((scope) =&gt; {\n        // 设置级别\n        scope.setLevel(this.mapLevelToSentry(level));\n\n        // 设置上下文\n        if (context) {\n          if (context.userId) {\n            scope.setUser({ id: context.userId });\n          }\n          if (context.metadata) {\n            scope.setContext('custom', context.metadata);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // 设置标签\n        if (tags) {\n          Object.entries(tags).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n            scope.setTag(key, value);\n          });\n        }\n\n        Sentry.captureException(error);\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 捕获消息\n   */\n  captureMessage(\n    message: string,\n    options?: {\n      level?: 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';\n      context?: ErrorContext;\n      tags?: Record&lt;string, string&gt;;\n    },\n  ) {\n    \n  }",

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * Sentry 错误追踪初始化\n */\nimport * as Sentry from '@sentry/react';\n\n/**\n * 初始化 Sentry\n */\nexport function initSentry() {\n  const sentryDsn = import.meta.env.VITE_SENTRY_DSN;\n\n  if (!sentryDsn) {\n    console.info('Sentry DSN 未配置，错误追踪已禁用');\n    return;\n  }\n\n  Sentry.init({\n    dsn: sentryDsn,\n    environment: import.meta.env.MODE || 'development',\n    integrations: [\n      Sentry.browserTracingIntegration(),\n      Sentry.replayIntegration({\n        maskAllText: true,\n        blockAllMedia: true,\n      }),\n    ],\n    tracesSampleRate: import.meta.env.MODE === 'production' ? 0.1 : 1.0,\n    replaysSessionSampleRate: import.meta.env.MODE === 'production' ? 0.1 : 1.0,\n    replaysOnErrorSampleRate: 1.0,\n    beforeSend(event, hint) {\n      // 过滤掉一些不重要的错误\n      if (event.exception) {\n        const error = hint.originalException;\n        if (error instanceof Error) {\n          // 忽略网络错误\n          if (error.message.includes('NetworkError') || error.message.includes('Failed to fetch')) {\n            return null;\n          }\n          // 忽略取消的请求\n          if (error.message.includes('canceled') || error.message.includes('aborted')) {\n            return null;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      return event;\n    },\n  });\n\n  console.info('Sentry 错误追踪已启用');\n}\n\n/**\n * 设置用户上下文\n */\nexport function setSentryUser(userId: string, metadata?: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;) {\n  Sentry.setUser({ id: userId, ...metadata });\n}",

        "contents": "class PrometheusMetrics {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Express 中间件：记录 HTTP 请求指标\n   */\n  middleware() {\n    return (req: any, res: any, next: any) =&gt; {\n      const startTime = Date.now();\n      this.activeConnections.inc();\n\n      res.on('finish', () =&gt; {\n        const duration = (Date.now() - startTime) / 1000; // 转换为秒\n        const route = req.route?.path || req.path || 'unknown';\n        const labels = {\n          method: req.method,\n          route,\n          status_code: res.statusCode.toString(),\n        };\n\n        // 记录请求持续时间\n        this.httpRequestDuration.observe(labels, duration);\n\n        // 记录请求总数\n        this.httpRequestTotal.inc(labels);\n\n        // 记录错误请求\n        if (res.statusCode &gt;= 400) {\n          this.httpRequestErrors.inc(labels);\n        }\n\n        this.activeConnections.dec();\n      });\n\n      next();\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新内存使用指标\n   */\n  updateMemoryMetrics() {\n    const usage = process.memoryUsage();\n  }",

        "contents": "# 监控与测试体系文档\n\n## 概述\n\n本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的监控体系和测试配置。\n\n## 监控体系\n\n### 1. 错误追踪\n\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/shared/infrastructure/monitoring/errorTracking.ts&#96;\n\n**功能**:\n- 捕获未处理的异常和 Promise 拒绝\n- 记录错误上下文（用户ID、会话ID、请求ID等）\n- 支持 Sentry 集成（可选）\n\n**使用示例**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { errorTracking } from '@/shared/infrastructure/monitoring/errorTracking';\n\n// 捕获异常\nerrorTracking.captureException(error, {\n  level: 'error',\n  context: { userId: '123', requestId: 'req-456' },\n  tags: { module: 'workflow' },\n});\n\n// 捕获消息\nerrorTracking.captureMessage('重要事件', {\n  level: 'info',\n  context: { action: 'user_login' },\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Sentry 集成**（已完成）:\n1. ✅ 已安装 &#96;@sentry/node&#96; 和 &#96;@sentry/react&#96;\n2. 设置环境变量: &#96;SENTRY_DSN=your-dsn&#96;（后端）或 &#96;VITE_SENTRY_DSN=your-dsn&#96;（前端）\n3. ✅ Sentry 已集成到错误追踪服务中，配置 DSN 后自动启用\n\n**详细配置**: 参见 &#96;docs/SENTRY_AND_PROMETHEUS.md&#96;\n\n### 2. 性能监控\n\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/shared/infrastructure/monitoring/performanceMonitor.ts&#96;\n\n**功能**:\n- 自动记录所有 HTTP 请求的性能指标\n- 检测慢请求（&gt;1秒）\n- 提供性能统计（平均响应时间、P50/P95/P99）\n\n**API 端点**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nGET /api/v1/monitoring/performance\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**响应示例**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"data\": {\n    \"total\": 1000,\n    \"avgDuration\": 150,\n    \"p50\": 120,\n    \"p95\": 300,\n    \"p99\": 500,\n    \"slowRequests\": [\n      {\n        \"method\": \"POST\",\n        \"path\": \"/api/workflow/ai-search\",\n        \"duration\": 1200,\n        \"statusCode\": 200,\n        \"timestamp\": \"2025-01-01T00:00:00Z\"\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Prometheus 指标导出\n\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/shared/infrastructure/monitoring/prometheusMetrics.ts&#96;\n\n**功能**:\n- ✅ 自动记录 HTTP 请求指标（持续时间、总数、错误数）\n- ✅ 监控活跃连接数和内存使用量\n- ✅ 导出 Node.js 默认指标（CPU、内存、事件循环等）",

        "contents": "export function setSentryTag(key: string, value: string) {\n\n}\n\n/**\n * 捕获异常\n */\nexport function captureException(error: Error, context?: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;) {\n  Sentry.withScope((scope) =&gt; {\n    if (context) {\n      scope.setContext('custom', context);\n    }\n    Sentry.captureException(error);\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * 捕获消息\n */\nexport function captureMessage(message: string, level: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' = 'info') {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "class PerformanceMonitor {\n  private metrics: PerformanceMetrics[] = [];\n  private readonly maxMetrics = 1000;\n\n  /**\n   * Express 中间件：记录请求性能\n   */\n  middleware() {\n    return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =&gt; {\n      const startTime = Date.now();\n\n      res.on('finish', () =&gt; {\n        const duration = Date.now() - startTime;\n        const metric: PerformanceMetrics = {\n          method: req.method,\n          path: req.path,\n          duration,\n          statusCode: res.statusCode,\n          timestamp: Date.now(),\n        };\n\n        this.recordMetric(metric);\n\n        // 记录慢请求\n        if (duration &gt; 1000) {\n          logger.warn('慢请求检测', {\n            method: req.method,\n            path: req.path,\n            duration,\n            statusCode: res.statusCode,\n          });\n        }\n      });\n\n      next();\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 记录性能指标\n   */\n  private recordMetric(metric: PerformanceMetrics) {\n    this.metrics.push(metric);\n  }",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "contents": "sequenceDiagram\n    participant U as 用户\n    participant F as 前端应用\n    participant B as 后端服务\n    participant D as Dify API\n    participant DB as 数据库\n    \n    U-&gt;&gt;F: 提交工作流请求\n    F-&gt;&gt;F: 表单验证\n    F-&gt;&gt;B: POST /api/workflows/{type}/run\n    B-&gt;&gt;B: 参数验证和映射\n    B-&gt;&gt;DB: 创建任务记录\n    B-&gt;&gt;D: 调用工作流API\n    \n    alt 流式响应\n        D--&gt;&gt;B: 流式数据块\n        B--&gt;&gt;F: SSE 事件流\n        F--&gt;&gt;U: 实时更新界面\n    else 阻塞响应\n        D-&gt;&gt;B: 完整结果\n        B-&gt;&gt;DB: 更新任务状态\n        B-&gt;&gt;F: 返回结果\n        F-&gt;&gt;U: 显示最终结果\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 数据流转图\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart LR\n    A[用户输入] --&gt; B[前端验证]\n    B --&gt; C[API请求]\n    C --&gt; D[后端验证]\n    D --&gt; E[字段映射]\n    E --&gt; F[工作流执行]\n    F --&gt; G[结果处理]\n    G --&gt; H[数据存储]\n    H --&gt; I[响应返回]\n    I --&gt; J[前端展示]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🔒 安全架构\n\n### 安全措施\n1. **输入验证**: 使用 Zod 进行运行时类型验证\n2. **CORS 配置**: 限制跨域访问来源\n3. **请求限制**: 实现 API 调用频率限制\n4. **错误处理**: 避免敏感信息泄露\n5. **日志记录**: 记录关键操作和异常\n\n### 安全配置示例\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// api/middleware/security.ts\nexport const securityMiddleware = [\n  helmet({\n    contentSecurityPolicy: {\n      directives: {\n        defaultSrc: [\"'self'\"],\n        styleSrc: [\"'self'\", \"'unsafe-inline'\"],\n        scriptSrc: [\"'self'\"],\n        imgSrc: [\"'self'\", \"data:\", \"https:\"]\n      }\n    }\n  }),\n  \n  rateLimit({\n    windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15分钟\n    max: 100, // 限制每个IP 100次请求\n    message: 'Too many requests from this IP'\n  }),\n  \n  (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =&gt; {\n    // 请求日志\n    logger.info(&#96;${req.method} ${req.path}&#96;, {\n      ip: req.ip,\n      userAgent: req.get('User-Agent')\n    });\n    next();\n  }\n];\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## ⚡ 性能优化\n\n### 前端优化\n1. **代码分割**: 使用 React.lazy 和 Suspense\n2. **缓存策略**: 实现智能缓存机制",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 96
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Todify3 部署问题解决知识库\n\n## 🚨 紧急问题快速解决\n\n### 1. 服务无法启动\n\n#### 问题现象\n- 端口无法监听\n- 进程启动失败\n- 服务无响应\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查端口占用\nlsof -i :3001\nlsof -i :3003\nlsof -i :8088\n\n# 检查进程状态\nps aux | grep node\nps aux | grep nginx\n\n# 检查日志\ntail -f /root/todify2-deploy/backend/backend.log\ntail -f /root/todify2-deploy/frontend/frontend.log\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n1. **端口冲突**: 杀死占用进程或更换端口\n2. **权限问题**: 检查文件权限和用户权限\n3. **依赖缺失**: 重新安装npm依赖\n4. **配置错误**: 检查.env文件和配置文件\n\n### 2. API 404错误\n\n#### 问题现象\n- &#96;Failed to load resource: 404&#96;\n- API端点无法访问\n- 代理路由失效\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查路由注册\ncurl http://localhost:3003/api/health\ncurl http://47.113.225.93:8088/api/health\n\n# 检查Nginx配置\nnginx -t\nsystemctl status nginx\n\n# 检查后端路由\ngrep -r \"app.use\" /root/todify2-deploy/backend/src/\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n1. **路由未注册**: 检查&#96;index.ts&#96;中的路由注册\n2. **Nginx配置错误**: 检查代理配置\n3. **路径错误**: 检查API路径配置\n4. **服务未启动**: 重启相关服务\n\n### 3. CORS错误\n\n#### 问题现象\n- &#96;Access to fetch at ... has been blocked by CORS policy&#96;\n- 跨域请求失败\n- API调用被阻止\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查前端API配置\ngrep -r \"apiUrl\" /root/todify2-deploy/frontend/src/services/\n\n# 检查后端CORS配置\ngrep -r \"cors\" /root/todify2-deploy/backend/src/\n\n# 测试直接API调用\ncurl -X POST http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/chat-messages \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"query\":\"test\"}'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n1. **使用代理**: 前端通过后端代理调用API\n2. **CORS配置**: 检查后端CORS中间件\n3. **URL配置**: 确保API URL指向代理地址\n4. **头部设置**: 检查请求头配置\n\n### 4. 超时错误\n\n#### 问题现象\n- &#96;Request timeout after 30000ms&#96;\n- &#96;fetchError: Request timeout&#96;\n- API调用超时\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

        "contents": "// Dify工作流代理\nrouter.post('/workflows/run', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Workflow Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    // 直接使用正确的Dify工作流API端点\n    const difyWorkflowUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/workflows/run';\n    console.log('Dify workflow URL:', difyWorkflowUrl);\n\n    const difyResponse = await axios.post(\n      difyWorkflowUrl,\n      { \n        ...requestBody, \n        user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n        response_mode: 'blocking' \n      },\n      {\n        headers: {\n          'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${apiKey}&#96;,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        timeout: 60000,\n      }\n    );\n    \n    console.log('Dify workflow response received:', difyResponse.status);\n    res.json(difyResponse.data);\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('Dify workflow proxy error:', error.message);\n    console.error('Error details:', error.response?.data);\n    res.status(error.response?.status || 500).json({\n      error: error.response?.data || error.message\n    });\n  }\n});\n\nexport default router;",

        "contents": "import type { ApiResponse, ApiErrorPayload } from '@/shared/types/api';\n\nclass ApiClient {\n  private readonly client: AxiosInstance;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.client = axios.create({\n      baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1',\n      timeout: 120_000, // 增加到120秒（2分钟），适应AI请求的较长响应时间\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.request.use((config) =&gt; {\n      const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');\n      if (token) {\n        config.headers = {\n          ...config.headers,\n          Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${token}&#96;,\n        };\n      }\n      return config;\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\n      (response) =&gt; response,\n      (error) =&gt; {\n        // 处理超时错误\n        if (error.code === 'ECONNABORTED' || error.message?.includes('timeout')) {\n          const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n            code: 'TIMEOUT_ERROR',\n            message: '请求超时，请稍后重试。AI处理可能需要较长时间，请耐心等待。',\n            details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n          };\n          return Promise.reject(apiError);\n        }\n\n        const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n          code: error.response?.data?.error?.code || 'API_ERROR',\n          message: error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message || '请求失败',\n          details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n        };\n\n        return Promise.reject(apiError);\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  private unwrap&lt;T&gt;(response: AxiosResponse&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt;): ApiResponse&lt;T&gt; {\n    \n  }",

        "contents": "async function startServer() {\n\n    \n    // 初始化公共知识库数据库表\n    try {\n      const { publicKnowledgeModel } = await import('./models');\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('公共知识库数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('公共知识库数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    const server = app.listen(port, \"0.0.0.0\", () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('Backend server 已启动', { url: &#96;http://0.0.0.0:${port}&#96; });\n    });\n\n    // 保持进程运行\n    server.keepAliveTimeout = 0;\n    server.headersTimeout = 0;\n\n    // 优雅关闭处理\n    process.on('SIGTERM', () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('SIGTERM received, shutting down gracefully');\n      server.close(() =&gt; {\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\n        process.exit(0);\n      });\n    });\n\n    process.on('SIGINT', () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('SIGINT received, shutting down gracefully');\n      server.close(() =&gt; {\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\n        process.exit(0);\n      });\n    });\n\n    return server;\n  } catch (error) {\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\n      level: 'fatal',\n    });\n    logger.error('Failed to start server', { error });\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n}\n\nstartServer();",

        "contents": "const RESERVED_ROUTES = [\n 'field-mapping-management'\n];\n\n/**\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\n */\nconst AddressPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { address } = useParams&lt;{ address: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&gt;(null);\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  // 加载公开页面配置\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&gt; {\n      if (!address) {\n        setError('地址参数缺失');\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 检查是否是保留路由\n      if (RESERVED_ROUTES.includes(address)) {\n        setError('该路径为系统保留路径');\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      try {\n        setConfigLoading(true);\n        setError(null);\n        // 根据地址查找配置\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(address);\n        if (configData &amp;&amp; configData.config) {\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\n        } else {\n          setError('未找到对应的页面配置');\n        }\n      } catch (err: any) {\n        console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\n        // 如果404，说明不是有效的地址配置，跳转到首页\n        if (err.response?.status === 404) {\n          navigate('/');\n          return;\n        }\n        setError(err.message || '加载配置失败');\n      } finally {\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadPublicConfig();\n  }, [address, navigate]);\n\n  // 处理节点执行\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any)\n;\n;",

error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 删除对话\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id\n */\nrouter.delete",

        "contents": "export class DifyGateway {\n\n\n  async executeChat(input: ChatInput): Promise&lt;Result&lt;ChatOutput&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await this.retry(() =&gt;\n        this.chatClient.post('/chat-messages', {\n          query: input.query,\n          conversation_id: input.conversationId,\n          inputs: input.inputs ?? {},\n          response_mode: 'blocking',\n          user: input.userId ?? 'todify-user',\n          files: [],\n        })\n      );\n\n      return success({\n        conversationId: response.data?.conversation_id,\n        messageId: response.data?.message_id,\n        answer: response.data?.answer,\n        raw: response.data,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      const axiosError = error as any;\n      const errorDetails = {\n        message: axiosError.message || (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)),\n        code: axiosError.code,\n        status: axiosError.response?.status,\n        statusText: axiosError.response?.statusText,\n        responseData: axiosError.response?.data,\n        requestUrl: axiosError.config?.url,\n        requestBaseURL: axiosError.config?.baseURL,\n        fullUrl: axiosError.config?.baseURL ? &#96;${axiosError.config.baseURL}${axiosError.config.url}&#96; : axiosError.config?.url,\n        errno: axiosError.errno,\n        syscall: axiosError.syscall,\n        address: axiosError.address,\n        port: axiosError.port,\n      };\n      logger.error('Dify executeChat 失败', { error: errorDetails, input });\n      console.error('Dify executeChat 详细错误:', JSON.stringify(errorDetails, null, 2));\n      \n      // 构建详细的错误消息\n      let errorMessage = errorDetails.message;\n      if (errorDetails.code) {\n        errorMessage += &#96; (${errorDetails.code})&#96;;\n      }\n      if (errorDetails.status) {\n        errorMessage += &#96; [HTTP ${errorDetails.status}]&#96;;\n      }\n      if (errorDetails.responseData) {\n        errorMessage += &#96;: ${JSON.stringify(errorDetails.responseData)}&#96;;\n      }\n      \n      return failure({\n        code: 'DIFY_CHAT_ERROR',\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// Dify聊天消息代理\nrouter.post('/chat-messages', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Chat Messages Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    console.log('API Key (first 10 chars):', apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...');\n    \n    // 直接使用Dify后端地址（9999端口）\n    const difyBaseUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\n    console.log('Dify base URL:', difyBaseUrl);\n\n    // 清理requestBody，确保只发送Dify需要的字段\n    const { appType: _, ...cleanedBody } = requestBody;\n    \n    console.log('发送给Dify的请求体:', {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs,\n      conversation_id: cleanedBody.conversation_id,\n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    });\n\n    // 正确的Dify API端点\n    const difyApiUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/chat-messages';\n    console.log('请求Dify API URL:', difyApiUrl);\n    \n    // 构建请求体，只在有有效conversation_id时才包含它\n    const requestPayload: any = {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs || {},\n      user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    };\n    \n    // 只在有有效conversation_id时才添加它\n    if (cleanedBody.conversation_id &amp;&amp; cleanedBody.conversation_id.trim() !== '') {\n      requestPayload.conversation_id = cleanedBody.conversation_id;\n    }\n    \n    console.log('最终发送给Dify的请求体:', requestPayload);\n    \n    const difyResponse = await axios.post\n;\n}",

{\n    const uploadDir = 'uploads/ai-roles/';\n    if (!fs.existsSync(uploadDir)) {\n      fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true });\n    }\n    cb(null, uploadDir);\n  },\n  filename: (req, file, cb) =&gt; {\n    // 生成唯一文件名，但保留原始扩展名\n    const uniqueSuffix = Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1E9);\n    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname);\n    cb(null, &#96;${uniqueSuffix}${ext}&#96;);\n  },\n});\n\nconst upload = multer({\n  storage: storage,\n  limits: {\n    fileSize: 50 * 1024 * 1024, // 50MB\n  },\n  fileFilter: (req, file, cb) =&gt; {\n    // 允许的文件类型\n    const allowedTypes = [\n      'image/jpeg',\n      'image/png',\n      'image/gif',\n      'image/webp',\n      'image/svg+xml',\n      'application/pdf',\n      'application/msword',\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',\n      'application/vnd.ms-excel',\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',\n      'text/plain',\n      'text/markdown',\n      'application/json',\n    ];\n    if (allowedTypes.includes(file.mimetype)) {\n      cb(null, true);\n    } else {\n      cb(new Error(&#96;不支持的文件类型: ${file.mimetype}&#96;));\n    }\n  },\n});\n\nconst fileService = new FileService();\n\n/**\n * 获取所有AI角色\n * GET /api/v1/ai-roles\n */\nrouter.get('/', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const roles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, roles, '获取AI角色列表成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取AI角色列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '获取AI角色列表失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 查找重复的AI角色\n * GET /api/v1/ai-roles/duplicates\n * 注意：必须在 /:id 路由之前定义，否则会被当作 id 处理\n */\nrouter.get('/duplicates', async (req, res) =&gt;   "contents": "import express from 'express';\nimport { formatApiResponse, formatValidationErrorResponse } from '../utils/validation';\nimport { publicPageConfigModel, agentWorkflowModel, aiRoleModel } from '../models';\nimport { CreatePublicPageConfigDTO, UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO } from '../models/PublicPageConfig';\n\nconst router = express.Router();\n\n/**\n * 获取所有公开页面配置\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs\n */\nrouter.get('/', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const configs = await publicPageConfigModel.getAll();\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, configs, '获取配置列表成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取配置列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '获取配置列表失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 预览配置（获取角色列表）\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/preview\n * 注意：这个路由必须在 /:id 之前定义，因为 Express 按顺序匹配路由\n */\nrouter.get('/:id/preview', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\n    \n    if (!config) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\n    }\n\n    let roles: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\n      // 获取所有启用的角色\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; r.enabled);\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;&amp; config.workflowId) {\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\n      if (workflow) {\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n      }\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; config.roleIds &amp;&amp; config.roleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 获取指定的角色\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n    }\n    \n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, { roles, config }, '获取配置预览成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取配置预览失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '获取配置预览失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 切换配置启用状态\n * PATCH /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/toggle\n * 注意：这个路由必须在 /:id 之前定义，因为 Express 按顺序匹配路由\n */\nrouter.patch('/:id/toggle', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const { isActive } = req.body;\n\n    console.log(&#96;[API] 切换配置状态请求: id=${id}, isActive=${isActive}, body=&#96;, req.body);\n\n    // 检查配置是否存在\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\n    if (!existingConfig) {\n      console.log(&#96;[API] 配置不存在: id=${id}&#96;);\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\n    }\n\n    console.log(&#96;[API] 当前配置状态: isActive=${existingConfig.isActive}&#96;);\n\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\n      isActive: typeof isActive === 'boolean' ? isActive : !existingConfig.isActive,\n    };\n\n    console.log(&#96;[API] 更新数据: isActive=${updateData.isActive}&#96;);\n\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\n\n    console.log(&#96;[API] 配置状态已更新: id=${id}, isActive=${updatedConfig.isActive}&#96;);\n\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '切换状态成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('[API] 切换状态失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '切换状态失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 获取单个配置\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\n */\nrouter.get('/:id', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\n    \n    if (!config) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\n    }\n    \n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '获取配置失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 创建公开页面配置\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs\n */\nrouter.post('/', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\n    \n    // 验证必填字段",

        "contents": "async function startServer() {\n\n    \n    // 初始化公共知识库数据库表\n    try {\n      const { publicKnowledgeModel } = await import('./models');\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('公共知识库数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('公共知识库数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    const server = app.listen(port, \"0.0.0.0\", () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('Backend server 已启动', { url: &#96;http://0.0.0.0:${port}&#96; });\n    });\n\n    // 保持进程运行\n    server.keepAliveTimeout = 0;\n    server.headersTimeout = 0;\n\n    // 优雅关闭处理\n    process.on('SIGTERM', () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('SIGTERM received, shutting down gracefully');\n      server.close(() =&gt; {\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\n        process.exit(0);\n      });\n    });\n\n    process.on('SIGINT', () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('SIGINT received, shutting down gracefully');\n      server.close(() =&gt; {\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\n        process.exit(0);\n      });\n    });\n\n    return server;\n  } catch (error) {\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\n      level: 'fatal',\n    });\n    logger.error('Failed to start server', { error });\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n}\n\nstartServer();",

        "contents": "class ErrorTrackingService {\n  private initialized = false;\n  private sentryEnabled = false;\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化错误追踪服务\n   */\n  init() {\n    if (this.initialized) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // 初始化 Sentry（如果配置了 DSN）\n    const sentryDsn = process.env.SENTRY_DSN;\n    if (sentryDsn) {\n      try {\n        Sentry.init({\n          dsn: sentryDsn,\n          environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',\n          tracesSampleRate: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 0.1 : 1.0,\n          beforeSend(event, hint) {\n            // 过滤掉一些不重要的错误\n            if (event.exception) {\n              const error = hint.originalException;\n              if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message.includes('ECONNREFUSED')) {\n                return null; // 忽略连接拒绝错误\n              }\n            }\n            return event;\n          },\n        });\n        this.sentryEnabled = true;\n        logger.info('Sentry 错误追踪已启用');\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('Sentry 初始化失败', { error });\n      }\n    } else {\n      logger.info('Sentry DSN 未配置，使用本地日志记录');\n    }\n\n    // 捕获未处理的异常\n    process.on('uncaughtException', (error) =&gt; {\n      this.captureException(error, {\n        level: 'fatal',\n        tags: { type: 'uncaughtException' },\n      });\n    });\n\n    // 捕获未处理的 Promise 拒绝\n    process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason) =&gt; {\n      this.captureException(\n        reason instanceof Error ? reason : new Error(String(reason)),\n        {\n          level: 'error',\n          tags: { type: 'unhandledRejection' },\n        },\n      );\n    });\n\n    this.initialized = true;\n    logger.info('错误追踪服务已初始化');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 捕获异常\n   */\n  captureException(\n    error: Error,\n    options?: {\n      level?: 'error' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'fatal';\n      context?: ErrorContext;\n      tags?: Record&lt;string, string&gt;;\n    },\n  ) {\n    \n  }",

        "contents": "class ErrorTrackingService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 捕获异常\n   */\n  captureException(\n    error: Error,\n    options?: {\n      level?: 'error' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'fatal';\n      context?: ErrorContext;\n      tags?: Record&lt;string, string&gt;;\n    },\n  ) {\n    const { level = 'error', context, tags } = options || {};\n\n    // 记录到日志\n    const logLevel = level === 'fatal' ? 'error' : level === 'warning' ? 'warn' : level;\n    logger[logLevel as 'error' | 'warn' | 'info'](error.message, {\n      error: {\n        name: error.name,\n        message: error.message,\n        stack: error.stack,\n      },\n      context,\n      tags,\n    });\n\n    // 发送到 Sentry\n    if (this.sentryEnabled) {\n      Sentry.withScope((scope) =&gt; {\n        // 设置级别\n        scope.setLevel(this.mapLevelToSentry(level));\n\n        // 设置上下文\n        if (context) {\n          if (context.userId) {\n            scope.setUser({ id: context.userId });\n          }\n          if (context.metadata) {\n            scope.setContext('custom', context.metadata);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // 设置标签\n        if (tags) {\n          Object.entries(tags).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n            scope.setTag(key, value);\n          });\n        }\n\n        Sentry.captureException(error);\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 捕获消息\n   */\n  captureMessage(\n    message: string,\n    options?: {\n      level?: 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';\n      context?: ErrorContext;\n      tags?: Record&lt;string, string&gt;;\n    },\n  ) {\n    \n  }",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowEngine {\nprivate async executeNode(\n    workflow: AgentWorkflow,\n    node: AgentWorkflowNode,\n    options: Required&lt;WorkflowExecutionOptions&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n catch (error) {\n      nodeResult.status = 'failed';\n      nodeResult.endTime = new Date();\n      nodeResult.duration = nodeResult.endTime.getTime() - nodeResult.startTime.getTime();\n      nodeResult.error = {\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n        stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined,\n      };\n\n      if (!options.continueOnError) {\n        throw error;\n      }\n\n      if (options.logging) {\n        console.error(&#96;节点执行失败: ${node.id}&#96;, error);\n      }\n    } finally {\n      this.notifyProgress();\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行Agent节点\n   */\n  private async executeAgentNode(node: AgentWorkflowNode, input: any): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// PostgreSQL 连接管理\nclass PostgreSQLManager {\n  private pool: Pool | null = null;\n\n  constructor(config: any) {\n    this.pool = new Pool(config);\n  }\n\n  async connect(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      const client = await this.pool!.connect();\n      console.log('✅ PostgreSQL数据库连接成功');\n      client.release();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('❌ PostgreSQL连接失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async query(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    if (!this.pool) {\n      throw new Error('数据库未连接');\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.pool.query(sql, params);\n      return result.rows;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('PostgreSQL查询错误:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async close(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    if (this.pool) {\n      await this.pool.end();\n      console.log('PostgreSQL数据库连接已关闭');\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 数据库管理器\nexport class DatabaseManager {\n  private sqliteManager: SQLiteManager | null = null\n}",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowController {\n\n\n  executeAiSearch = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const conversationIdInput = req.body.conversationId ?? req.body.conversation_id;\n      const normalizedConversationId = typeof conversationIdInput === 'string' ? conversationIdInput : '';\n\n      const normalizedPayload: { query: unknown; inputs?: unknown; conversationId: string } = {\n        query: req.body.query,\n        inputs: req.body.inputs,\n        conversationId: normalizedConversationId,\n      };\n\n      const dto = validateDTO&lt;ExecuteAiSearchDTO&gt;(ExecuteAiSearchSchema, normalizedPayload);\n      const result = await this.executeAiSearchUseCase.execute(dto);\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          createErrorResponse(result.error.code, result.error.message, result.error.details)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(createSuccessResponse(result.value, 'AI搜索完成'));\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('AI 搜索接口执行失败', { error });\n      next(error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  executeTechPackage = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const payload = {\n        inputs: req.body.inputs ?? {},\n        conversationId: req.body.conversationId ?? req.body.conversation_id,\n      };\n      const dto = validateDTO(ExecuteTechPackageSchema, payload);\n      const result = await this.executeTechPackageUseCase.execute(dto);\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          createErrorResponse(result.error.code, result.error.message, result.error.details)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(createSuccessResponse(result.value, '技术包装完成'));\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('技术包装接口执行失败', { error });\n      next(error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  executeTechStrategy =\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { KnowledgePointService } from '../services/knowledgePointService';\nimport { CreateKnowledgePointDTO, UpdateKnowledgePointDTO } from '../types/database';\n\nconst router = Router();\nconst knowledgePointService = new KnowledgePointService();\n\n// 创建知识点\nrouter.post('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const data: CreateKnowledgePointDTO = req.body;\n    \n    // 验证必填字段\n    if (!data.tech_point_id || !data.title || !data.content) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '技术点ID、标题和内容为必填字段'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const knowledgePoint = await knowledgePointService.createKnowledgePoint(data);\n    \n    res.status(201).json({\n      success: true,\n      data: knowledgePoint,\n      message: '知识点创建成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('创建知识点失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '创建知识点失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "# API 契约文档\n\n本文档描述了 Todify3 前后端统一的 API 契约规范。\n\n## 统一响应格式\n\n所有 API 响应遵循以下统一格式：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface ApiResponse&lt;T = unknown&gt; {\n  success: boolean;\n  data?: T;\n  error?: ApiErrorPayload;\n  message?: string;\n}\n\ninterface ApiErrorPayload {\n  code: string;\n  message: string;\n  details?: unknown;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 成功响应示例\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"data\": {\n    \"id\": \"123\",\n    \"name\": \"示例数据\"\n  },\n  \"message\": \"操作成功\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 错误响应示例\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": false,\n  \"error\": {\n    \"code\": \"VALIDATION_ERROR\",\n    \"message\": \"请求参数验证失败\",\n    \"details\": {\n      \"errors\": [\n        {\n          \"field\": \"query\",\n          \"message\": \"Query parameter is required\",\n          \"value\": null\n        }\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 标准错误代码\n\n| 错误代码 | 说明 | HTTP 状态码 |\n|---------|------|------------|\n| &#96;VALIDATION_ERROR&#96; | 请求参数验证失败 | 400 |\n| &#96;UNAUTHORIZED&#96; | 未授权 | 401 |\n| &#96;FORBIDDEN&#96; | 禁止访问 | 403 |\n| &#96;NOT_FOUND&#96; | 资源不存在 | 404 |\n| &#96;DIFY_CHAT_ERROR&#96; | Dify 聊天服务调用失败 | 500 |\n| &#96;DIFY_WORKFLOW_ERROR&#96; | Dify 工作流服务调用失败 | 500 |\n| &#96;AI_SEARCH_FAILED&#96; | AI 搜索执行失败 | 500 |\n| &#96;WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED&#96; | 工作流执行失败 | 500 |\n| &#96;INTERNAL_ERROR&#96; | 服务器内部错误 | 500 |\n\n## 分页响应格式\n\n对于列表接口，使用分页响应格式：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface PaginatedResponse&lt;T&gt; extends ApiResponse&lt;T[]&gt; {\n  meta?: {\n    page: number;\n    pageSize: number;\n    total: number;\n    totalPages: number;\n  };\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 验证错误响应\n\n当请求参数验证失败时，返回详细的验证错误：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface ValidationErrorResponse extends ApiResponse&lt;never&gt; {\n  error: {\n    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR';\n    message: '请求参数验证失败';",

        "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行工具调用\n   * @param toolCall 工具调用信息\n   * @param toolConfig 工具配置\n   * @returns 执行结果（JSON 字符串）\n   */\n  async executeTool(toolCall: ToolCall, toolConfig: ToolConfig): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 解析参数\n      const args = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments || '{}');\n\n      // 验证参数\n      this.validateParameters(args, toolConfig.parameters);\n\n      // 根据工具类型执行\n      let result: ToolExecutionResult;\n\n      switch (toolConfig.type) {\n        case 'search':\n          result = await this.executeSearch(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'calculation':\n          result = this.executeCalculation(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'time':\n          result = this.getTime(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'api':\n          result = await this.executeAPI(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'workflow':\n          result = await this.executeWorkflow(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'agent':\n          result = await this.executeAgent(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        default:\n          result = {\n            success: false,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;不支持的工具类型: ${toolConfig.type}&#96; })\n          };\n      }\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return JSON.stringify({ error: result.error || '工具执行失败' });\n      }\n\n      return result.content;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(&#96;工具执行失败: ${toolConfig.name}&#96;, error);\n      return JSON.stringify({\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '工具执行失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 验证参数\n   */\n  private validateParameters(args: any, parameters: ToolConfig['parameters']): void {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行工作流（异步）\n   */\n  async executeWorkflow(\n    workflowId: string,\n    options: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&gt; {\n    // 获取工作流定义\n    const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(workflowId);\n    if (!workflow) {\n      throw new Error('工作流不存在');\n    }\n\n    const startedAt = Date.now();\n    // 创建执行实例\n    const execution = await workflowExecutionModel.create({\n      execution_type: 'agent_workflow',\n      workflow_id: workflowId,\n      workflow_name: workflow.name,\n      status: 'running',\n      shared_context: options.input || {},\n      node_results: [],\n      start_time: new Date().toISOString(),\n    });\n\n    try {\n      // 解析工作流节点和边\n      const nodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\n      const edges = JSON.parse(workflow.edges || '[]');\n\n      logger.info('开始执行工作流', {\n        workflowId,\n        workflowName: workflow.name,\n        nodesCount: nodes.length,\n        edgesCount: edges.length,\n        nodeTypes: nodes.map((n: any) =&gt; n.type),\n        agentNodes: nodes.filter((n: any) =&gt; n.type === 'agent').map((n: any) =&gt; ({\n          id: n.id,\n          agentId: n.agentId || n.data?.agentId,\n          hasData: !!n.data,\n        })),\n        outputNodes: nodes.filter((n: any) =&gt; n.type === 'output').map((n: any) =&gt; ({\n          id: n.id,\n          outputs: n.data?.outputs,\n        })),\n      });\n\n      // 检查是否有配置的Agent节点\n      const hasConfiguredAgent = this.workflowHasConfiguredAgent(workflow);\n      logger.info('检查Agent节点配置', {\n        workflowId,\n        hasConfiguredAgent,\n      });\n      \n      if (!hasConfiguredAgent) {\n        const fallbackOutput = this.buildFallbackOutput;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": " '../models/AgentWorkflow';\nimport { agentWorkflowModel, workflowExecutionModel, workflowTemplateModel, aiRoleModel } from '../models';\nimport { formatApiResponse } from '../utils/validation';\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport DifyClient from './DifyClient';\nimport { DifyGateway } from '@/shared/infrastructure/integrations/dify';\nimport { isSuccess } from '@/shared/lib/result';\nimport { AgentOrchestrator } from './agent/AgentOrchestrator';\n\n/**\n * Agent工作流服务\n */\nexport class AgentWorkflowService {\n  /**\n   * 验证工作流是否有效\n   */\n  async validateWorkflow(workflow: AgentWorkflow): Promise&lt;{ isValid: boolean; errors: string[] }&gt; {\n    const errors: string[] = [];\n\n    try {\n      // 解析nodes和edges\n      const nodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\n      const edges = JSON.parse(workflow.edges);\n\n      // 检查节点是否为空\n      if (!Array.isArray(nodes) || nodes.length === 0) {\n        errors.push('工作流必须至少包含一个节点');\n      }\n\n      // 检查节点ID唯一性\n      const nodeIds = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n      for (const node of nodes) {\n        if (nodeIds.has(node.id)) {\n          errors.push(&#96;节点ID重复: ${node.id}&#96;);\n        }\n        nodeIds.add(node.id);\n      }\n\n      // 检查边的有效性\n      for (const edge of edges) {\n        if (!nodeIds.has(edge.source)) {\n          errors.push(&#96;边的源节点不存在: ${edge.source}&#96;);\n        }\n        if (!nodeIds.has(edge.target)) {\n          errors.push(&#96;边的目标节点不存在: ${edge.target}&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 检查是否有环\n      if (this.hasCycle(nodes, edges)) {\n        errors.push('工作流包含循环依赖，请检查边的连接');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      errors.push(&#96;JSON解析失败: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    return {\n      isValid: errors.length === 0,\n      errors,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 检查是否有环\n   */\n  private hasCycle(nodes: any[], edges: any[]): boolean {\n    const visited = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n  }\n}",

JSON.parse(wf.metadata) : wf.metadata) : undefined,\n          published: wf.published === 1 || wf.published === true || wf.published === '1' || wf.published === 'true',\n        };\n      }\n      throw new Error(response.data.error || '创建工作流失败');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\n      \n      // 对于500错误或连接错误（后端未运行），提供更友好的错误信息\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        const friendlyError = new Error('后端服务器未运行，请启动后端服务器后重试');\n        // 完全静默处理，不输出任何日志\n        throw friendlyError;\n      }\n      \n      console.error('创建工作流失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新工作流\n   */\n  async updateWorkflow(id: string, data: Partial&lt;AgentWorkflow&gt;): Promise&lt;AgentWorkflow&gt; {\n    \n  }",

        "contents": "const WorkflowCanvas: React.FC&lt;WorkflowCanvasProps&gt; = \n\n  \n  // 同步外部节点和边变化到内部状态\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 检查节点是否真的发生了变化（包括数据变化）\n    // 使用 JSON.stringify 来深度比较节点数据\n    const currentNodesStr = JSON.stringify(nodes.map(n =&gt; ({\n      id: n.id,\n      type: n.type,\n      data: n.data,\n      position: n.position,\n    })));\n    const incomingNodesStr = JSON.stringify(initialNodes.map(n =&gt; ({\n      id: n.id,\n      type: n.type,\n      data: n.data,\n      position: n.position,\n      agentId: n.agentId,\n    })));\n    \n    const nodesChanged = currentNodesStr !== incomingNodesStr;\n    \n    // 只在非内部更新且节点确实变化时同步外部变化\n    if (!isInternalUpdateRef.current &amp;&amp; nodesChanged) {\n      originalNodesRef.current = initialNodes;\n      const newNodes = convertToReactFlowNodes(initialNodes);\n      setNodes(newNodes);\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = false; // 外部更新不需要通知回去\n      \n      // 延迟执行fitView以确保DOM已更新，并确保所有节点都在视口内\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        if (reactFlowInstanceRef.current &amp;&amp; newNodes.length &gt; 0) {\n          reactFlowInstanceRef.current.fitView({ \n            padding: 0.2, \n            duration: 400,\n            includeHiddenNodes: false,\n            minZoom: 0.1,\n            maxZoom: 2\n          });\n        }\n      }, 200);\n    }\n    isInternalUpdateRef.current = false;\n  }, [initialNodes, convertToReactFlowNodes, setNodes, nodes]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 检查边是否真的发生了变化\n    const currentEdgeIds = new Set(edges.map(e =&gt; e.id));\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const WorkflowPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (isDifyConfigsError || isWorkflowConfigsError) {\n      console.error(\"加载配置失败:\", { difyConfigsError, workflowConfigsError });\n      setConfigsLoaded(true);\n    }\n  }, [isDifyConfigsError, isWorkflowConfigsError, difyConfigsError, workflowConfigsError, setConfigsLoaded]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (aiRolesData) {\n      setWorkflowAgents(aiRolesData);\n    }\n  }, [aiRolesData, setWorkflowAgents]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (!agentWorkflowsData) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const workflow = agentWorkflowsData.find((item) =&gt; item.name === \"智能工作流\");\n\n    if (!workflow) {\n      setSmartWorkflow(null);\n      setUseAgentWorkflow(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setSmartWorkflow(workflow);\n    setUseAgentWorkflow(true);\n\n    const edges = workflow.edges;\n    const getOrder = (nodeId: string, cache = new Map&lt;string, number&gt;()): number =&gt; {\n      if (cache.has(nodeId)) {\n        return cache.get(nodeId)!;\n      }\n\n      const incoming = edges.filter((edge) =&gt; edge.target === nodeId);\n      if (incoming.length === 0) {\n        cache.set(nodeId, 0);\n        return 0;\n      }\n\n      const order = Math.max(...incoming.map((edge) =&gt; getOrder(edge.source, cache))) + 1;\n      cache.set(nodeId, order);\n      return order;\n    };\n\n    const workflowSteps = workflow.nodes\n      .slice()\n      .sort((a, b) =&gt; getOrder(a.id) - getOrder(b.id))\n      .map((node, index) =&gt; {\n        const label = node.data.label || node.data.agentName || &#96;步骤${index + 1}&#96;;\n        const mappedKey = mapStepLabelToKey(label);\n        const Icon = iconByIndex[index] || FileText;\n        const agent = aiRolesData?.find((item) =&gt; item.id === node.agentId);\n\n        return {\n          id: index,\n          title: label,\n          description: index === 0 ? \"进行中\" : \"未开始\",\n          icon: Icon,\n          key: mappedKey,\n          status: index === 0 ? \"active\" : \"pending\",\n          agentId: node.agentId,\n          agent,\n        };\n      });\n\n    setSteps(workflowSteps as any);\n  }, [agentWorkflowsData, aiRolesData,\n;",

        "contents": "const WorkflowCanvas: React.FC&lt;WorkflowCanvasProps&gt; = \n\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 检查边是否真的发生了变化\n    const currentEdgeIds = new Set(edges.map(e =&gt; e.id));\n    const incomingEdgeIds = new Set(initialEdges.map(e =&gt; e.id));\n    const edgesChanged = \n      edges.length !== initialEdges.length ||\n      !initialEdges.every(e =&gt; currentEdgeIds.has(e.id)) ||\n      !edges.every(e =&gt; incomingEdgeIds.has(e.id));\n    \n    // 只在非内部更新且边确实变化时同步外部变化\n    if (!isInternalUpdateRef.current &amp;&amp; edgesChanged) {\n      const newEdges = convertToReactFlowEdges(initialEdges);\n      setEdges(newEdges);\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = false; // 外部更新不需要通知回去\n    }\n    isInternalUpdateRef.current = false;\n  }, [initialEdges, convertToReactFlowEdges, setEdges, edges]);\n\n  // 监听内部节点状态变化并同步到外部（仅当是用户操作时）\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (shouldNotifyRef.current &amp;&amp; externalNodesChange) {\n      const updatedNodes = convertFromReactFlowNodes(nodes, originalNodesRef.current);\n      externalNodesChange(updatedNodes);\n      // 更新ref以保持同步\n      originalNodesRef.current = updatedNodes;\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = false;\n    }\n  }, [nodes, externalNodesChange, convertFromReactFlowNodes]);\n\n  // 监听内部边状态变化并同步到外部（仅当是用户操作时）\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (shouldNotifyRef.current &amp;&amp; externalEdgesChange) {\n      const updatedEdges = convertFromReactFlowEdges(edges);\n      externalEdgesChange(updatedEdges);\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = false;\n    }\n  }, [edges, externalEdgesChange, convertFromReactFlowEdges]);\n\n  // 处理节点变化（仅更新内部状态）\n  const handleNodesChange = useCallback(\n    (changes: any) =&gt; {\n      isInternalUpdateRef.current = true;\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = true;\n      onNodesChange(changes);\n    },\n    [onNodesChange]\n  );\n\n  // 处理边变化（仅更新内部状态）\n  const handleEdgesChange = useCallback\n;\n;",

已修复 500 内部服务器错误。主要改动：

## 修复内容

1. **创建异步错误处理包装器** (`backend/src/shared/lib/asyncHandler.ts`)
   - 自动捕获异步路由处理函数中的错误
   - 统一错误处理和日志记录

2. **改进全局错误处理中间件** (`backend/src/index.ts`)
   - 检查响应是否已发送，避免重复发送
   - 记录更详细的错误信息（URL、方法、路径、参数、查询等）
   - 根据错误类型返回适当的状态码
   - 开发环境返回错误堆栈

3. **修复 JSON.parse 调用**
   - 在 `index.ts` 和 `publicPageConfig.ts` 中为 `JSON.parse(workflow.nodes)` 添加错误处理
   - 解析失败时返回空角色列表，而不是抛出错误导致 500

4. **导出 asyncHandler 工具**
   - 在 `shared/lib/index.ts` 中导出，供路由使用

## 改进效果

- 所有异步错误都会被正确捕获和处理
- JSON 解析错误不会导致 500 错误
- 错误日志更详细，便于调试
- 避免重复发送响应

这些改动应能解决 500 错误。如果仍有问题，请查看服务器日志以获取更详细的错误信息。
